entry.title: FM Radio Chip Bring-Up_Troubleshooting Manual
entry.content:
Unisoc SC9832A FM Radio Troubleshooting Manual — spd-box

Audience: Engineers / AI who encounter problems while bringing up FM
Iron rule of troubleshooting: Locate the layer top-down; skipping layers is not allowed. If any layer is not working and you guess upward from it, you will inevitably waste time
Core value: Chains “symptom → most likely root cause → verification command → fix” into a single decision table, locating the layer within 5 minutes

0. Troubleshooting Discipline (Read First; Violating It Wastes Time)

  1. Layer first, act second. Five layers: ① firmware ② power-up ③ driver ④ daemon ⑤ UI. Use the quick-reference table in §1 to locate the layer.
  2. Display/audio conclusions must be confirmed by human eyes and ears; “logs return OK” must not be substituted for “there really is a picture/sound”.
  3. For every path, first write a minimal, no-frills reproduction before discussing a fix.
  4. Do not repeat already-confirmed hard facts (see FM收音打通_AI指导手册.md §2), and do not retread already-verified dead ends (§10).

1. Layered Troubleshooting Quick-Reference Master Table (One-Page Location)

SymptomLayerPreferred verification commandJump
/dev/fm cannot be opened (ENOENT)③ Driverls /dev/fm && grep -w fm /proc/misc§3.1
0x2331 cannot be read on SDIO①② Firmware/power-upcat /sys/bus/sdio/devices/*/device§2.1
WiFi is fine, but FM does not respond② Power-upps | grep wcnd§2.2
ioctl returns -EINVAL③ Wrong command numberdmesg | tail (check for ----<命令名>----)§3.2
ioctl returns OK but there is no sound③/④ Audio pathcat /proc/asound/pcm | grep -i fm§4
There is sound but it is noisy / extremely quiet④ Volume chainCompare GETVOL with the actual listening impression§4.3
RSSI is constantly 0 or an extreme value③/⑤ Tuning failurePerform a single-point TUNE on a known strong-signal station§5.1
seek does not return / gets stuck③ Driver timeoutdmesg | grep 'seek Timeout'§5.2
LVGL page freezes⑤ socket blockingCheck whether SO_RCVTIMEO is set§6.1
FM and Bluetooth make sound at the same time⑤ Missing arbitrationCheck the audio focus module§6.3
FM stops working after a rebootAutostart orderrc-service fm-radio status§7.1
Station drops on screen-off/background③ PM suspensiondmesg | grep -i suspend§7.3

2. Firmware / Power-Up Layer (①②)

2.1 SDIO Cannot Be Read / device Is Not Equal to 0x2331

  • Root cause: download did not start or the firmware was not burned → the combo chip as a whole is not online, so FM of course does not exist either.
  • Fix: first bring up WiFi according to the 01_WiFi打通 documentation. download must stay resident; do not kill it.
  • Note: there is only this one device on SDIO, and WiFi/Bluetooth/FM all share it; there is no independent “FM enumeration”.

2.2 WiFi Is Normal but FM Does Not Respond to Commands

  • Root cause: the wcnd power-up step is missing, so the chip’s powered state is incomplete (especially evident for the FM part).
  • Fix: add the wcnd + bt_once(BT-OPEN) steps, referring to §3 of 02_蓝牙打通/docs/蓝牙芯片打通_操作手册.md.

3. Driver Layer (③)

3.1 /dev/fm Does Not Exist

  • Note: marlin_fm is depended on by sprdwl (Used by sprdwl in lsmod),
    so when unloading it you must handle the dependent party as well; do not rashly rmmod WiFi that is carrying business traffic.
  • Under normal circumstances this should not happen: the module is already loaded automatically when WiFi is brought up.

3.2 ioctl Returns -EINVAL / -ENOTTY (This Project’s Number One Fault)

  • Judgment: the driver prints ----<命令名>---- for each command.

    • If you sent command A but dmesg prints /----B----/ → the command number mapping is wrong;
    • If dmesg has no new prints at all → the command number did not land in any known branch.

  • Fix: check the conclusion table of “FM收音ioctl命令表_逆向还原” and verify nr. All command numbers have been reverse-engineered, so only two possibilities remain here: “copied incorrectly” or “used an undefined range”; this is no longer a blocker.

  • 🔒 Do not use brute-force full traversal: sending ioctls at random may put the firmware into an abnormal state. Only perform controlled single-step probing, and prepare a reset method.

3.3 dmesg Shows seek Timeout(%d sec), fm seek end !

  • This is the driver’s built-in seek timeout mechanism, not a bug (the string comes from the driver source code).
  • The upper layer must be equipped accordingly: the daemon/UI must also have its own timeout fallback, and after a timeout it must show a “no station found” prompt, so the UI does not spin forever.

4. Audio Layer (Whether There Is Sound) — The Layer Most Prone to “Thinking It Works”

4.1 ioctl Succeeds but There Is No Sound

Possible causeInvestigation
The correct audio path is not selectedTry in order ANA_SWITCH (default) → I2S_SETTING → OVER_BT_ENABLE, confirming each one by ear
The main output volume is not turned onThis device has no amixer; you can only write code using libasound.so.2 to query the mixer; SETVOL may only be the FM module’s internal gain
Headphones are not plugged in but the design depends on the headphone antennaTune to the strongest station and listen without headphones; if headphones are mandatory, the UI must give a clear prompt
The channel is occupied by someone else (A2DP/local playback)See §6.3

⚠️ Logs must not be used to determine whether there is sound. There is no necessary connection between TUNE returning OK and “hearing the broadcast”.

4.2 Sound Is Intermittent / Feels Choppy

  • Check fm_suspend / fm_resume: the driver implements dev_pm_ops, so FM is very likely to be suspended along with the system (see §7.3).
  • Check SDIO bandwidth: FM shares SDIO with WiFi/Bluetooth, so high WiFi throughput may have an impact — this is an inherent characteristic of the shared chip and needs evaluation by measurement.

4.3 Volume Is Wrong / SETVOL Has No Effect

  • First confirm whether the GETVOL return value changes with the value you write:
    • If it changes → the FM internal gain is in effect, but the main output (codec/speaker) volume is a separate chain that must go through ALSA;
    • If it does not change → the command did not succeed or the value range is wrong (the value range needs calibration by measurement).

5. Tuning / Scan Layer

5.1 RSSI Is Constantly 0 or a Fixed Extreme Value

  • If even a single point cannot yield a reasonable value → go back to §3.2 (command numbers) or §4 (antenna/path).
  • If a single point is OK but scanning is wrong → check the usage of SCAN / SCAN_GETRSSI.

5.2 Scanning Is Very Slow / Cannot Be Stopped Midway

  • The full band is 87.5–108.0 MHz with a 100 kHz step ≈ 205 frequency points, and each point requires a dwell measurement → being slow is normal.
  • The UI must: ① show percentage progress; ② show the number of stations found; ③ provide a clickable Stop button (STOP_SCAN).
  • The daemon side must also set an overall timeout; it cannot wait indefinitely.

6. Application Layer (④⑤ daemon → socket → LVGL)

6.1 LVGL Page Freezes / Page Switching Does Not Respond

  • Root cause: socket I/O is performed inside an LVGL timer callback, and the daemon does not respond → the UI thread is blocked.
  • Fix (mandatory):
  • This is exactly the same pitfall already encountered on the Bluetooth page.

6.2 connect /tmp/fm_ctl.sock Fails

  • The daemon did not start → run it manually once and look at the output (./fm_radio_daemon in the foreground).
  • The socket exists but cannot be connected to → check for leftover old socket files (the daemon should unlink the old socket at startup).

6.3 FM and Bluetooth A2DP / Local Playback Make Sound at the Same Time

  • Root cause: the three share one audio output, with no arbitration.
  • Fix: implement an audio focus module (see §5.4 of FM收音机_LVGL界面设计与交互规格.md):
    • FM encounters A2DP → automatically mute (not close), and after A2DP ends ask whether to resume;
    • A2DP encounters FM → pop up a confirmation dialog; after the user agrees, pause/disconnect A2DP and then FM takes over;
    • Local playback and FM are mutually exclusive.
  • ⚠️ Note that the semantics of OVER_BT_ENABLE are not yet confirmed (whether it means “send FM sound to Bluetooth” or “allow coexistence”); measure first, then write the arbitration.

6.4 Station Stops After Returning to the Desktop / Station Drops on Screen-Off

  • In onPause, calling close or mute is forbidden; only stop UI timers/callbacks.
  • The playback state is held by the daemon, decoupled from the page lifecycle.
  • If the station drops on screen-off: check whether fm_suspend is triggered by the system PM (see §7.3).

7. System / Autostart Layer

7.1 FM Is Not Automatically Available After a Reboot

  • Number one root cause: the autostart order precedes the WiFi power-up chain, so the chip is not yet powered when FM starts.
  • Fix: declare after for WiFi/power-up-related services in the openrc service’s depend().
    The correct chain: logdw → download → wcnd → bt_once → bt_wake → bt_user_daemon → fm_radio_daemon.

7.2 The Daemon Restarts Repeatedly

  • Check whether it is a misjudgment by <the on-device watchdog>; during debugging, be sure to kill processes by PID,
    do not use pkill -f <pattern> — it will match the shell itself carrying the command and kill your own SSH session.

7.3 FM Drops the Station After Screen-Off / System Suspension

  • The driver symbols contain fm_suspend / fm_resume (static functions, shown as t by nm), indicating that dev_pm_ops is implemented.
  • If the product requires “continued listening with the screen off”, extra handling is needed (holding a lock or preventing suspend) — this must be confirmed by measurement and cannot be assumed.

8. Diagnostic Toolbox (Quick Reference for Key Nodes)

PurposeCommand
One-shot checkupSee the six-part script in §1.2 of 操作手册.md
Driver command name liststrings /lib/modules/marlin_fm.ko | grep -- '----' | sed 's/.*----//;s/----//' | sort
RDS function listnm /lib/modules/marlin_fm.ko | grep ' T ' | grep rds_
Evidence of shared SDIOstrings /lib/modules/marlin_fm.ko | grep description=
Whether ioctl lands in the correct branchdmesg -c >/dev/null → send the command → dmesg | tail, look for ----<命令名>----
Whether the FM PCM existscat /proc/asound/pcm | grep -i fm
socket connectivitySee the python3 snippet in §6.1
seek timeout logsdmesg | grep 'seek Timeout'

9. Items Still Requiring Measurement and Calibration (Currently Not Established Facts)

ItemWhy it matters
ioctl command numbersBlock the entire workflow
Whether it depends on headphones as the antennaDetermines whether the UI needs a “please insert headphones” prompt
The exact semantics of OVER_BT_ENABLEDetermines how to write the channel arbitration
The relationship between SETVOL and the main output volumeDetermines which chain volume control goes through
The RSSI threshold boundariesDetermines how many bars the signal bar draws (do not copy dBm values from the internet; this device returns raw driver values)
FM behavior during system suspendDetermines the feasibility of “continued listening with the screen off”

10. Verified Dead Ends (Do Not Retry)

RouteConclusion
Looking for Unisoc FM source code in /tmp/linux-3.10.65❌ That is a vanilla tree; it has no private FM source code
Looking for an off-the-shelf FM command-line tool❌ There is none anywhere on the disk; you must write your own daemon
Using amixer/tinymix to switch paths❌ These tools are not installed on this device; you can only write code calling the ALSA lib
Directly dynamically loading Android’s libFMHalSource.so❌ It depends on the Android runtime and cannot run under Alpine

11. Red Lines (Under Any Circumstances)

  1. Writing SSH passwords/accounts/real IPs in documentation is forbidden.
  2. Audio/display conclusions must be confirmed by ear and eye; “logs OK” is not accepted as a pass criterion.
  3. Socket I/O inside LVGL must have timeouts set.
  4. Kill processes by PID; pkill -f matching strings that could hit your own command line is forbidden.
  5. Before committing, check git diff --stat and git diff --ignore-cr-at-eol --stat (main.c is the only CRLF file in the whole repository).

entry.title: HT0FM Radio Principles and Porting Study Wiki
entry.content:
HT0 FM Radio Principles and Porting Study Wiki

Audience: Engineers who want to understand “what is really going on with this chip’s FM”, as well as those who will port to other platforms in the future
How to read: §0–§2 build intuition → §3 understand the software/hardware layering → §4 see how Android does it → §5 see how we do it → §8 troubleshooting methodology → §9 migration checklist
Core value: Facts scattered across .ko symbols, the ALSA topology, and the Android vendor libraries, organized into a readable chain of knowledge

0. Build Intuition in One Sentence

On this chip, the FM radio is not a standalone piece of hardware, but the third functional module inside the Marlin2 “three-in-one” chip.

Its RF, demodulation, and RDS decoding are all completed inside the chip; externally it exposes only one control channel over SDIO and one /dev/fm character device.
What you can do in Linux user space is essentially only three things: give it commands, ask it for field strength, and connect the audio it produces to the codec.

1. What the Hardware Looks Like

1.1 One Chip, Three Functions

Measured evidence:

FactValueHow to obtain
SDIO modaliassdio:c00v0000d2331cat /sys/bus/sdio/devices/*/modalias
SDIO device pathmmc2:8800:1ls /sys/bus/sdio/devices/
vendor / device0x0000 / 0x2331cat .../vendor, .../device
Official statement on shared SDIOSDIO radio driver for marlin2 FM Radio Receivers, share SDIO with BT/WIFIstrings /lib/modules/marlin_fm.ko | grep description=

The last row is the most critical one: the driver author states in writing that FM and BT/WiFi share SDIO.
This determines that all of FM’s availability dependencies (firmware, power-up) are bound together with WiFi/Bluetooth.

1.2 What “Shared SDIO” Means

Impact areaDescription
Firmwaredownload burns the combo firmware as a whole in one go, including the FM part. There is no independent FM firmware process
Power-upThere is no independent FM power-up switch; the chip simply needs to be powered as a whole (it depends on the wcnd / BT-OPEN chain)
BandwidthSDIO is a shared bus, so high WiFi throughput may theoretically affect the FM data stream; this needs evaluation by measurement
Fault couplingIf WiFi dies ⇒ SDIO does not enumerate ⇒ FM is necessarily unavailable. Troubleshooting must confirm WiFi first

2. Software Layering (Five-Layer Model)

The “pass criteria” corresponding to each layer (this is the basis for layered troubleshooting):

LayerPass criterion
① Hardwarecat /sys/bus/sdio/devices/*/device yields 0x2331
② FirmwareWiFi can come up (download stays resident)
③ Driverlsmod | grep marlin_fm, ls /dev/fm, and grep -w fm /proc/misc yields 23 fm
④ daemonconnect /tmp/fm_ctl.sock succeeds and state returns OK *
⑤ UICan tune stations, hear sound, and return to the desktop without stopping playback

3. The Boundary of Capabilities Provided by the Driver: Command List and RDS

3.1 Control Commands (from the Debug Prints of strings marlin_fm.ko)

The driver prints ----<命令名>---- for each ioctl branch; the commands are recovered accordingly:

CategoryCommands
BasicTUNE、TUNE_NEW、SEEK、SEEK_NEW、MUTE、SETVOL、GETVOL、IS_FM_POWERED_UP
ScanSCAN、SCAN_NEW、STOP_SCAN、SCAN_GETRSSI、PRE_SEARCH、RESTORE_SEARCH
SignalGETRSSI、GETMONOSTERO、SETMONOSTERO、SOFT_MUTE_TUNE、DESENSE_CHECK、IS_DESE_CHAN、CQI_GET、FULL_CQI_LOG
AudioANA_SWITCH、I2S_SETTING、GET_I2S_INFO、GET_AUDIO_INFO、OVER_BT_ENABLE
RDSRDS_SUPPORT、RDS_ONOFF、RDS_GROUPCNT、RDS_BC_RST
InformationGETCHIPID、GET_HW_INFO、GETCAPARRAY、GETCURPAMD、GETGOODBCNT、GETBADBNT、GETBLERRATIO
Mass-production debuggingRW_REG、TOP_RDWR、HOST_RDWR、DUMP_REG、EM_TEST、SIM_DATA、GET_LOG

✅ Update (2026-09-22): the command numbers have been fully reverse-engineered and confirmed by measurement; see
FM收音ioctl命令表_逆向还原.md.
The encoding is unified as _IOWR(0xF5, nr, 4) = 0xC004F500 | nr, with 45 of the 47 commands passing measurement.
This section is retained as a functional-perspective classification; for the actual numbers, consult that document.

3.2 AT Command Style — Confirmed by Measurement, and It Is Real

The driver contains two functions, parse_at_fm_cmd / parse_at_fm_num; on the Android side, libengfm.so exports only one symbol, fm_runcommand
(literally translated, “run an FM command”).

This is not speculation; AT frames have actually been captured. The complete kernel log when calling TUNE:

Conclusions:

  1. What the driver sends over SDIO is indeed AT text, in the format at+fm=<opcode>,<param>
    (at+fm=1,0 is 10 characters + NUL = 11 bytes, which matches fm_sdio_write size: 11).
  2. The AT opcode and the ioctl nr are two separate numbering schemes: the ioctl nr of TUNE is 0x02, but its AT opcode is 1.
    So far only power up -> at+fm=0 and TUNE -> at+fm=1,<freq> have been confirmed. The full AT table is not yet calibrated; do not mix the two schemes.
  3. Another byproduct: TUNE is a blocking call, and the failure path takes about 3.99 s (the log timestamp span
    11448.618 → 11452.613). Therefore the daemon must run TUNE/SEEK on a dedicated thread, and the socket must have timeouts set.

3.3 RDS — The Differentiating Value of This Project

nm marlin_fm.ko reveals a complete RDS parser:

FieldFunctionLength/meaning
PSrds_get_psStation name, 8 characters
RTrds_get_rtRadio text, 64 characters (scrolling subtitles)
PTYrds_get_ptyProgram type (news/classical/rock…)
PIrds_get_pi_codeProgram identification code
AFrds_get_af / rds_get_af_methodAlternative frequencies — automatically switch to another frequency of the same program when the signal degrades
TP/TArds_get_tp_taTraffic program / traffic announcement
CTrds_get_ctStation clock
DI/MSrds_get_di_msDecoder identification / music-speech
EWSrds_get_ewsEmergency broadcast (has compliance significance)
PTYN / PIN / SLCrds_get_ptyn / rds_get_pin / rds_get_slcProgram type name / item number / SLC
ODA / TDCrds_get_oda / rds_get_oda_aid / rds_get_tdcOpen data application / transparent data channel
EONrds_get_eon / rds_get_eon_taEnhanced other network information

This means the radio app is not merely “able to make sound”, but can display station names, scrolling text, and program types, and can even track frequencies automatically.
When designing the UI, be sure to make use of these capabilities; do not degenerate it into an interface with only frequency digits.

4. How Native Android Does It (Reference Sample)

The vendor Android partition is mounted at /mnt/android_sys on the device and can be browsed directly:

ComponentPathDescription
FM HAL audio source/mnt/android_sys/lib/libFMHalSource.soThe android::FMHalSource class
Engineering mode library/mnt/android_sys/lib/libengfm.soExports only fm_runcommand
JNI bridge/mnt/android_sys/lib/libfmjni.soJava ↔ native
Broadcast serviceslibradio.so / libradioservice.so / libradio_metadata.soThe standard broadcast radio HAL stack
Service APK/mnt/android_sys/priv-app/radio_interactor_service/Upper-layer service
Driver/mnt/android_sys/lib/modules/marlin_fm.koThe same copy loaded on this device

4.1 The Audio Architecture Read from libFMHalSource.so

nm -D shows that the class holds:

  • pcmHandle (tinyalsa PCM handle)
  • mSamplerate / mPeriodSize / mPeriodCount / mChannel
  • A background thread FMHalThread::threadLoop()
  • A RingBuffer (GetData/PutData/GetBuf/PutBuf/BufCount)

Conclusion: the Android side is a typical audio pipeline that starts a thread to read data from PCM, passes it through a ring buffer, and then hands it to the audio output.
The daemon we write ourselves on Alpine essentially has to replicate this same chain (though a simpler implementation can be used).

4.2 Why These Libraries Cannot Be Directly Reused

They depend on the Android runtime (Android infrastructure such as binder, sp<> smart pointers, ALooper, and RingBuffer),
and cannot run when dynamically loaded on Alpine. They can only serve as a reference sample / source of facts, not as reusable components.

5. Our Approach: Replacing an Entire Stack with Minimal Code on Alpine

5.1 Design Trade-offs

DecisionChoiceReason
Whether to rewrite the FM protocol stackNoIt is already implemented inside the chip; we only send commands
Control channelWrite an FM daemon that exclusively owns /dev/fmAvoids multi-process contention; consistent with the approach of the Bluetooth daemon
External interfaceunix socket + plain-text commandsFully mirrors the existing bt_user_daemon (/tmp/bt_ctl.sock), minimizing the team’s learning cost
Audio outputTry the internal codec passthrough first (ANA_SWITCH)I2S and Over-BT serve as alternatives, pending measurement
UI carrierLVGL radio pageHomogeneous with the desktop’s other apps

5.2 Why “Mirroring bt_user_daemon” Is the Right Choice

The Bluetooth daemon is already a pattern validated by the team:

FM copies this set exactly: it likewise reduces the cognitive burden of some inexplicable new protocol, and the pitfalls of socket timeouts and reconnection have already been encountered once.

5.3 The Pitfall You Must Remember: Socket Timeout

🔒 When performing socket I/O inside an LVGL timer callback, you must set SO_RCVTIMEO / SO_SNDTIMEO (200ms recommended).
Otherwise, once the daemon stops responding, the entire UI thread freezes. This is a hard lesson already learned on this project’s Bluetooth page; FM must not step into it again.

6. Audio Path: Three Possibilities, One Must Be Chosen by Measurement

Measured ALSA topology of this device:

The three corresponding driver ioctls:

PathioctlStatus
Analog/internal codec passthroughANA_SWITCHDefault candidate
I2SI2S_SETTING / GET_I2S_INFOAlternative
FM audio over BluetoothOVER_BT_ENABLESemantics to be confirmed

Current tooling: this device has libasound.so.2, but does not have amixer / tinymix / aplay
→ mixer adjustments cannot be done from the command line; C code must be written.

Not yet confirmed (must not be treated as fact):

  1. Whether FM requires headphones to be plugged in as the antenna (the existence of 01-04 suggests it may not, but this needs measurement);
  2. The exact semantics of OVER_BT_ENABLE;
  3. Whether SETVOL is the FM module’s internal gain or the main output volume.

7. Three Words: Uncertainty

The key items in this Wiki that have not yet been measured must be confirmed one by one before formal work begins (listed together here for easy comparison):

#Item to confirmImpact
1ioctl command numbersBlock the entire workflow; without them, no commands can be sent
2Whether it depends on the headphone antennaDetermines whether the UI needs a “please insert headphones” state
3OVER_BT_ENABLE semanticsDetermines the channel arbitration logic
4SETVOL scopeDetermines the volume control chain
5RSSI raw value units and thresholdsDetermines how the signal bar is drawn
6FM behavior during system suspendDetermines whether “continued listening with the screen off” is possible

This list is itself a deliverable: stating clearly “what is known and what is not” has more engineering value than pretending to know everything.

8. Troubleshooting Methodology (Follow This When Migrating)

  1. Layer first: ①② firmware/power-up → ③ driver → ④ daemon → ⑤ UI. If any layer is not working, do not guess at the layers above.
  2. Let the nodes speak: lsmod / ls /dev/fm / /proc/misc / sdio device — these four commands determine life or death.
  3. Whether ioctls are correct is seen in dmesg: the driver prints ----<命令名>----, which is the only direct evidence for judging whether the command number mapping is correct.
  4. Audio must not be judged from logs: it must be listened to by human ear.
  5. When the UI freezes, first suspect socket blocking: check whether timeouts are set.

9. General Checklist for Migrating to Similar Devices

To migrate this FM solution to another similar device (Unisoc Marlin series), do the following in order:

  1. Confirm SDIO enumeration: cat /sys/bus/sdio/devices/*/device, and check whether the device id matches.
  2. Confirm the driver: lsmod | grep <fm driver name>, ls /dev/<fm node>.
  3. Confirm the sharing relationship: strings <fm driver>.ko | grep description=, and find out whether it shares SDIO with WiFi/BT.
  4. Pull the command list: strings <driver>.ko | grep -- '----', plus nm <driver>.ko | grep ' T '.
    Going one step further — reverse-engineer the command numbers as well: use file <driver>.ko to see whether it is not stripped,
    then objdump -d --disassemble=<ioctl function> and read the constants in the binary search tree.
    If the driver prints ----<命令名>----, confirm each one by measurement using “single-step calls with all-zero parameters + clearing the log with dmesg -c“.
    If you can figure it out yourself, do not list it as something “to be requested from the original manufacturer”.
  5. Confirm the audio topology: cat /proc/asound/pcm | grep -i fm.
  6. Find the userspace gap: is there an off-the-shelf FM tool? (This device has none; you need to write your own daemon)
  7. Mirror the existing daemon pattern: copy the usage of the socket daemon whose success has already been validated on this device.
  8. Run through the six pending confirmation items in §7 again — the answers may differ on different devices, so do not copy this device’s conclusions verbatim.

10. What This Wiki Wants You to Remember

FM is “already there”, not “something to be built”.

FM is in the chip, FM is in the firmware, FM is lying in the driver, and even the RDS parser is already written —
there are only three engineering tasks we really have to do: wrap the operations on /dev/fm into a daemon, connect the audio to the codec, and draw a UI that can use RDS.

And the matter of “information gaps” is much easier to solve than imagined.
Initially we listed “cannot obtain the ioctl command numbers” as the number one hard blocker, and were even prepared to beg the original manufacturer for the header file.
In the end we discovered: the .ko is not stripped, and the command numbers lie in plain sight in the machine code;
plus the driver prints each command’s name into the kernel log, so locating candidates via disassembly + single-step measurement with all-zero parameters nailed down all 47 commands.

So the first priority is not “go ask for the header file”, but rather — first check whether it is needed at all.

Copyright: This article is an original work by whiteleibniz (organized with AI assistance). All rights reserved. Please credit the source and keep the original link: https://whiteleibniz.github.io

entry.title: FM Radio_LVGL UI Design and Interaction Specification
entry.content:
Unisoc SC9832A (spd-box) FM Radio —— LVGL UI Design and Interaction Specification

Audience: Engineers / AI assistants implementing the radio app
How to use: Read §1–§2 first to get the screen and hardware constraints → arrange icons per §3 → draw pages per §4 → break down feature priorities per §5
Core value: All dimensions are computed from measured on-device parameters (720×1280 portrait screen, lv_font_cn_16 line height 31px), avoiding line-height rework after drawing; every feature item is annotated with its corresponding driver ioctl, avoiding the design of interactions that cannot be implemented

1. Design Constraints (Fix Them First, Then Draw Pages)

1.1 Screen and Font Hard Parameters

ItemValueSource / Impact
Resolution720 × 1280 (portrait)Measured from the framebuffer; all coordinates are based on this
LVGL version9.6.0Use 9.x APIs such as lv_obj_set_style_transform_rotation
Default Chinese fontlv_font_cn_16Forbidden to use LV_FONT_DEFAULT (Montserrat-14 has no CJK glyphs and renders tofu blocks)
lv_font_cn_16 metricsline_height = 31px, base_line = 9pxCritical: the nominal font size is 16px, but each line actually occupies 31px. Any layout estimated at 16px will inevitably clip Chinese text
Icon fontFontAwesome codepoint coverage 61441 ~ 63650 (0xF001–0xF8A2)Icon selection must fall within this range
Physical buttonsOrder (点餐) = 114 (LEFT), Service (服务) = 102 (RIGHT), Benefits (福利) = 115 (ENTER), Checkout (买单) = 116 (BACK)Navigation/back goes through buttons; without a touchscreen, blind operation must be possible

⚠️ Historical lesson for this project: Rework has already occurred because line heights (36/60px) were hardcoded according to the old font, which clipped Chinese text.
All y coordinates in this specification have been recomputed on a 31px grid; during implementation, do not “visually fine-tune” them into a 16px grid.

1.2 Hardware Capability Boundaries (What the UI Can Display)

The following capabilities have been verified by measurement via driver symbols (see FM收音打通_AI指导手册.md §2); the UI design makes trade-offs accordingly:

Driver capabilityCorresponding UI elementNotes
TUNE / TUNE_NEWManual tuning, list frequency jumpDirect frequency setting, fast response
SEEK / SEEK_NEW◀◀ / ▶▶ station searchFinds the next strong signal; it is not a step-by-step frequency increment
SCAN / SCAN_NEW / STOP_SCAN / SCAN_GETRSSIAutomatic full-band scan + progress bar + interruptibleThe four commands work as a set: SCAN initiates the full scan, SCAN_GETRSSI samples the field strength point by point to drive progress and noise filtering, STOP_SCAN cancels midway
GETRSSISignal strength indicator barReal-time query of a single frequency point
MUTE / SETVOL / GETVOLMute toggle, volume sliderNote: SETVOL still exists, but the main output volume may go through ALSA separately; see the arbitration table in §5
RDS_SUPPORT / RDS_ONOFFRDS switch (turned on/off by the upper layer)Recommended to keep on
rds_get_ps()Station name PS (8 characters) → the station name under the current frequencyThe most valuable RDS field
rds_get_rt()Radio text RT (64 characters) → scrolling subtitlesUsed for second-line scrolling
rds_get_pty()Program type (news/music/traffic…)Can be displayed as a small label
rds_get_af()Alternative frequencies AF → can automatically switch to a better-signal frequency of the same programHigh-value enhancement, not P0
rds_get_ct()Station clockCan serve as an optional source for the status bar time
rds_get_ews()Emergency broadcastHas compliance significance; reserve a notification slot
GETMONOSTERO / SETMONOSTEROStereo ST indicator lightMono/stereo indication
OVER_BT_ENABLERoute FM audio over BluetoothThe core switch for channel arbitration in §5.4
ANA_SWITCH / I2S_SETTING / GET_I2S_INFOAnalog cntl vs I2S: selection between two audio pathsImplementing either one is sufficient; see §5.4

⚠️ Must be verified by measurement (currently pending items; do not treat them as fact)

  1. Whether headphones must be plugged in to serve as the FM antenna. A common approach for the chip-side FM RF input is to reuse the headphone cable; this device’s ALSA topology contains a dedicated FM device
    (01-04: Dfm sprd-codec-fm-4), which suggests headphones may not be required. The approach must not be decided until the §5.4 audio path experiment is complete;
    if headphones turn out to be required, the UI must show a full-screen illustration prompting “please insert headphones” when no headphones are present (see state Z2 in §4.1).
  2. Although the RDS parsing functions exist in the driver, there is no header file evidence that user space has been provided with data structures; Struct number is undetermined.
  3. The relationship between the SETVOL volume and the actual main output volume: it may only be the internal gain of the FM module, with the main volume elsewhere in ALSA.

2. System Positioning: Where the Radio Sits in the Overall App

Relationship with existing pages:

PageRelationshipInteraction
Network page g_network_pagePrerequisite dependencyThe FM firmware is downloaded once together with WiFi; if WiFi is not up ⇒ FM is unavailable (the icon must be grayed out or a prompt shown)
Bluetooth page g_bluetooth_pageChannel mutual exclusionOpening FM during A2DP playback ⇒ requires upper-layer arbitration; see §5.4
Music/video pagesChannel mutual exclusionLocal playback and FM are mutually exclusive
Launcher g_launcher_pageReturn relationshipReturning does not stop playback; see §5.5

3. Entry Design and Icon (Requirement ①)

3.1 Desktop Grid Layout

Current s_apps[] order (starting at line 94 of lv_pages/launcher_page.c):

IndexNamesymbolBackground color
6NetworkLV_SYMBOL_WIFI0x56ccf2
7BluetoothLV_SYMBOL_BLUETOOTH0x1e88e5
8Radio (new)See §3.20xe6614f (recommended)
9 (formerly 8)Gallery……

The visual order is determined by the s_apps[] array order (grid traversal uses sizeof(s_apps)/sizeof(s_apps[0]), see launcher_page.c:985 and :1055),
so as long as it is placed after the Bluetooth entry in the array, it is automatically rendered after Bluetooth.

3.2 Three Code Changes (All Mandatory; None Can Be Skipped)

(1) Enum — the enum near line 40 of launcher_page.c:

⚠️ It is recommended not to insert the enum in the middle of implicitly consecutive values: the style above shifts the numeric values of GALLERY and all following entries by +1.
If you are worried that some state has persisted old numeric values, the safer approach is to append it at the end of the enum (before LAUNCHER_APP_EXTERN = 1000),
and the visual order is still controlled by the s_apps[] array. Choose one of the two approaches and apply it consistently across the whole project.

(2) Array — s_apps[]:

(3) Jump branch — the switch in open_app:

The standard jump pattern is identical to other pages (lv_start_activity(&g_xxx_page, LV_PAGE_FLAG_DEFAULT, LV_PAGE_ANIM_SLIDE_LEFT, 220)).

3.3 Icon Selection

LVGL’s built-in symbols contain no dedicated radio symbol. There are three candidates:

CandidateCodepointDecimalWithin the confirmed coverage rangeAssessment
broadcast-towerU+F51962745✅ Within 61441–63650Recommended first choice: tower shape, high recognizability
podcastU+F2CE62158✅Alternative, leans toward “podcast” semantics
satellite-dishU+F7C063424✅Alternative, leans toward “satellite” semantics
radioU+F8CE63702❌ Exceeds 63650Forbidden to use; it renders as a tofu block

The background color is recommended to be 0xe6614f (warm brick red): in the desktop’s existing palette, blues are already heavily used by Network/Gallery/Bluetooth, and the red family is used only by Power Off (0xe74c3c) and Music (0xeb5757); warm brick red clashes with none of these three, and a warm tone matches the conventional psychological association of “radio/broadcast”.

3.4 Icon Verification (Mandatory Before Delivery; Without This Step the Work Is Not Complete)

Range coverage is indirect evidence; whether a codepoint has an actual glyph must be verified by measurement:

⚠️ Self-certification by “it looks right when rendered” is forbidden: this is consistent with this project’s troubleshooting discipline for display issues
(“capture data → decode per hypothesis → looks correct” is not evidence). It must be confirmed by human eyes on the physical screen that the glyph is a tower pattern rather than a box.

If U+F519 lacks a glyph → fallback options: use a 32×32 PNG resource, or fall back further to LV_SYMBOL_AUDIO (semantically conflicting with “Music”; not recommended).

3.5 Settings Page Layout

Two new items are recommended in the settings page g_settings_page (placed after the Bluetooth item):

ControlPurpose
Toggle “Radio boot autostart”Controls whether fm_radio.start starts with the system (off by default; see §5.5)
Entry “Radio region and band”China 87.5–108.0 MHz / 100 kHz step; leave room for Japan 76–90 MHz and the European 50 kHz step

These two items belong to P2 and can be added after P0/P1 are complete.

4. Page Layout (Requirement ②)

4.1 Zone Overview (720 × 1280)

Typeset on a 31px line-height grid, with 8 vertical zones:

#Zoney rangeHeightContent
ATitle bar0 – 7272Back button, title “Radio”, headphone/channel status mini-icons
BBand mode bar80 – 11131FM + 87.5 – 108.0 MHz + 100 kHz + ST stereo badge
CCurrent frequency120 – 232112Large font 97.4 + MHz; RDS station name PS below
DRuler244 – 34096Frequency scale + tuning pointer + favorite frequency markers
ESignal and RDS352 – 41361RSSI five-bar signal bar + RT scrolling text
FControl area430 – 590160◀◀ / seek / mute / seek / ▶▶
GFavorites list606 – 1110504Scrollable ListView: frequency + station name + delete
HVolume and channel1128 – 1264136Volume slider + mute + output channel indicator (speaker/headphone/Bluetooth)

A 16px margin serves as the divider between zones (○ padding = 16).

4.2 Zone Detailed Specifications

A. Title Bar (0–72)

ElementPosition / sizeDescription
Back buttonx=0, 56×56, LV_SYMBOL_LEFTClick → return to the desktop but do not stop playback (see §5.5)
TitleCentered, lv_font_cn_16“Radio”
Headphone statusx = 720-56Show 🎧 crossed out when no headphones are present; hidden when headphones are present. Depends on pending item 1 in §1.2
Channel indicatorImmediately adjacent on the leftSmall badge “Headphone / Speaker / Bluetooth”, linked with zone H; clicking can pop up the channel switch window (P2)

B. Band Mode Bar (80–111)

A single 31px row carries four pieces of information: [FM] [87.5 - 108.0 MHz] [100 kHz] [ST].
The ST stereo badge lights up only when GETMONOSTERO reports stereo, serving as an indirect indicator of RDS availability.

C. Current Frequency (120–232) — Visual Focus

ElementSpecification
Frequency digits48px bold (needs to be introduced or use the largest existing size; if lv_font_cn_16 has no such size, use an LVGL scale transform or add a new bitmap font size)
Unit MHz16px, right-aligned with the digits
RDS station name16px single line, taken from rds_get_ps(); show blank or “—“ when there is no RDS
Font-size reminderThe zone height is 112px, accommodating one 48px line (62px line area) + one 16px line (31px) + adjustment slack

⚠️ The 48px Chinese font size must first be verified against reality (lv_font_cn_16 is a 16px bitmap font).
If that font size is unavailable, there are two alternatives:
the first is to enlarge the digits using LVGL’s lv_obj_set_style_transform_scale() (enlarged bitmap fonts show jagged edges, so the effect is mediocre);
the second is to add a new 48px Chinese/digit bitmap font (best effect, but it increases firmware size). This item is a P1 dependency and must be decided after measurement.

D. Ruler and Tuning Pointer (244–340) — Core Interactive Component

  • Scale generation: computed from the current band bounds and step (default 87.5–108.0 MHz / 100 kHz); draw major ticks (every 1 MHz) + minor ticks (every 0.5 MHz).
  • Pointer: an inverted triangle whose x is linearly mapped from the current frequency; update it with lv_obj_set_x(), with a 200ms ANIM on switching.
  • Favorite markers: draw small ★-shaped markers at the x positions of the corresponding frequencies; marker positions update in real time as favorites are added or removed.
  • Interaction:
    • Drag / swipe left or right → fine frequency adjustment (every 10px of movement ≈ 100 kHz), with a real-time TUNE updating the zone C digits.
    • Tap a position on the scale → TUNE directly to that frequency.
    • Physical LEFT/RIGHT keys (114/102) → ±100 kHz fine adjustment (essential for accessibility without a touchscreen).

E. Signal Strength and RDS Text (352–413)

ElementSourceSpecification
RSSI five-bar signal barGETRSSIPolling period recommended at 500ms; the strong/weak thresholds must be calibrated by measurement (no samples currently; during implementation, use /tmp/fmtest to print the raw values and find the boundaries)
RT scrolling textrds_get_rt()64 characters; scroll when too wide; hide when there is no RDS

⚠️ RSSI thresholds must be calibrated by measurement; do not copy generic values such as -85dBm from the internet — this device’s GETRSSI returns raw driver values whose units are unknown.

F. Control Area (430–590)

Five button slots in 3 categories of buttons (96×96 round buttons are recommended, vertically centered in one ribbon):

ButtonIconBehaviorDriver call
Previous frequency ◀◀LV_SYMBOL_PREVSEEK down (find the next strong signal)SEEK(dir=0)
Search ⟲LV_SYMBOL_REFRESHShort press = single seek; long press = automatic full-band scanSEEK / SCAN
Mute 🔇LV_SYMBOL_MUTEToggle FM muteMUTE
Next frequency ▶▶LV_SYMBOL_NEXTSEEK upSEEK(dir=1)

Automatic scan: triggered by long-pressing ⟲ for ≥ 800ms; during scanning the button becomes “Stop”, and STOP_SCAN can interrupt it.
During scanning it is also recommended to disable the remaining buttons to avoid state machine confusion.

G. Favorites Channel List (606–1110)

Implemented with lv_list, each row 62px high (two lines of text at 31px each):

  • Frequency on the left + station name (left blank when there is no RDS station name)
  • Delete button LV_SYMBOL_CLOSE on the right (or long-press a row to pop up a delete confirmation, preventing accidental taps)
  • Tap a row → TUNE to that frequency and scroll the list to the top
  • For data persistence, see §5.6

H. Volume and Channel (1128–1264)

ElementDescription
Volume sliderlv_slider, with its range bound to SETVOL/GETVOL (the value range is yet to be determined; see pending item 3 in §1.2)
Mute buttonLinked with the mute in zone F (same state, bidirectionally synchronized)
Output channel indicatorText control showing the channel currently held by the winning contender: speaker / headphone / Bluetooth A2DP

4.3 Page Interaction Flow (State Machine)

4.4 Page Registration Pattern (Strictly Follow Existing Conventions)

Add lv_pages/radio_page.c / radio_page.h:

⚠️ Two red lines (verbatim from the comments in lv_pm/lv_page_manager.h):

  1. In onDestroy you must release your own timers and callbacks and null out self-built global UI pointers;
  2. In onDestroy do not delete page->root; the root node is deleted uniformly by the page manager.

Also: the SIM page stack has a maximum depth of 8; the favorites list page can use flags such as LV_PAGE_FLAG_NO_HISTORY as needed.

5. Feature List (Requirement ③)

5.1 Priority Overview Table

IDFeaturePriorityDependencyDriver call
F01Turn FM on/offP0WiFi is up (firmware downloaded)fm_powerup / fm_powerdown
F02Manual tuning TuneP0F01TUNE / TUNE_NEW
F03Automatic station search Seek (next strong signal)P0F01SEEK / SEEK_NEW
F04Full-band scan Scan + progress + interruptibleP0F01SCAN / SCAN_GETRSSI / STOP_SCAN
F05Signal strength display RSSIP0F02/F03GETRSSI
F06Mute / unmuteP0F01MUTE
F07Volume adjustmentP0F01SETVOL / GETVOL
F08FM daemon + socket interfaceP0F01 (the daemon is the sole entry point for all UI operations)/tmp/fm_ctl.sock
F09LVGL radio page (§4 layout)P0F08—
F10Boot autostart + firmware dependency checkP1The WiFi autostart chain is readyopenrc service
F11Favorites channel list (add/delete/jump)P1F02—
F12State persistence (last frequency/volume/favorites)P1F11—
F13RDS station name PS displayP1F02, RDS_ONOFF onrds_get_ps
F14RDS text RT scrollingP1F13rds_get_rt
F15Stereo ST indicationP1F02GETMONOSTERO
F16Background playback + screen-off persistenceP1F08, page lifecycle—
F17Channel arbitration (FM / A2DP / local mutual exclusion)P0F08, Bluetooth daemon§5.4
F18RDS program type PTY labelP2F13rds_get_pty
F19RDS alternative frequency AF automatic switchingP2F13rds_get_af
F20Settings page: region/band switchingP2——
F21RDS emergency broadcast EWS notificationP2F13rds_get_ews
F22RDS station clock CTP2F13rds_get_ct

Why F17 is P0: FM, Bluetooth A2DP, and local music all share one audio output.
Without arbitration, the most typical failures are “FM and A2DP making sound at the same time” or “the Bluetooth speaker still making sound after FM is turned off” — problems users are bound to encounter.

5.2 Dependency Order (Implementation Path)

5.3 FM Daemon Interface (Mirroring the Existing Pattern of bt_user_daemon)

The Bluetooth daemon uses a unix socket + plain-text commands (send state / on / off, receive OK ...\n); FM is advised to copy this pattern exactly:

ItemBluetooth (existing, reference)FM (new, recommended)
socket path/tmp/bt_ctl.sock/tmp/fm_ctl.sock
Permissionschmod(SOCK_PATH, 0666)Same
ProtocolText command + \n terminator, replying OK <payload>\nSame
Typical commandsstate / on / off / scan-relatedstate, open, close, tune <freq_khz>, `seek <0

🔒 Timeouts are mandatory: LVGL timer callbacks that perform socket I/O must set SO_RCVTIMEO / SO_SNDTIMEO (200ms recommended),
otherwise a stuck daemon will freeze the UI thread directly. This is a hard lesson already learned on this project’s Bluetooth page.

5.4 Channel Arbitration (FM / A2DP / Local Playback Mutual Exclusion) — Key Design

The driver exposes three FM audio output paths:

PathSwitchApplicable scenarioPriority recommendation
Analog/internal codecANA_SWITCHDirect output to this device’s speaker / headphoneDefault
I2SI2S_SETTING / GET_I2S_INFOWhen an external codec is neededAlternative (needs measurement to confirm availability)
Over BTOVER_BT_ENABLEFM sound output from a Bluetooth headphone/speakerOptional when Bluetooth is connected

Recommended arbitration rules (implement a single “audio focus” module in the LVGL main process; the daemon only manages devices):

Current holderNew requesterHandling
IdleFMAcquire directly; select the default path per the §5.4 table (headphone inserted → headphone, otherwise speaker)
IdleA2DPAcquire directly
FMA2DPFM mutes automatically (not close); after A2DP ends, ask whether to resume FM
A2DPFMPop up a confirmation dialog: “Bluetooth is playing. Switch to the radio?” → if agreed, pause/disconnect A2DP and then FM takes over
Local playback (music/video)FMStop local playback → FM takes over
FMLocal playbackFM mutes → local playback takes over

⚠️ OVER_BT_ENABLE is the key uncertainty of this design: whether it actually “sends FM audio to a connected Bluetooth device”,
or “allows FM and BT to coexist”, has not been confirmed by reading the code.
Before implementation, its behavior must first be probed with a minimal program, and only then should the arbitration logic be written. Starting without confirming this will very likely lead to wrong measurements.

5.5 Background Playback and Screen-Off Persistence

RequirementImplementation points
Keep playing when returning to the desktoponPause only stops UI timers/callbacks and does not call close or mute; the playback state is held by the daemon, decoupled from the page lifecycle
Page fully destroyedonDestroy likewise does not stop playback (same reason); only an explicit user press of close or shutdown stops it
Keep playing with the screen offScreen-off is managed by the system backlight; FM is played by the daemon and does not depend on LVGL heartbeats. Needs measurement: confirm that screen-off does not trigger fm_suspend (the driver contains fm_suspend / fm_resume, which are the entry points for PM suspension; be sure to verify whether FM drops the station when the system suspends)
Boot autostartFollow the existing openrc autostart pattern of bt_user_daemon; before autostart, the WiFi chain must be confirmed up (firmware dependency; see step 0 in §5.2)

⚠️ The driver symbol table contains two static functions fm_suspend / fm_resume (t rather than T), indicating that the driver implements dev_pm_ops.
When the system suspends, FM is very likely to be suspended along with it. If the product requires continued listening with the screen off, extra handling is needed (wakelock or forbidding suspend); this item must be verified by measurement and cannot be assumed.

5.6 State Persistence

Recommended path /etc/fm_radio.conf (or follow the project’s existing configuration storage convention); choose either JSON or INI:

FieldDescription
last_freqLast listened frequency (kHz); restore to this frequency on boot
volumeLast volume
mutedMute state
rds_onRDS switch (recommended to keep on)
band/regionRegion/band (P2)
favorites[]Favorites list: {freq, name}

Write timing: on program exit, 1s debounce after frequency switching, and immediately when favorites are added or removed.

6. One-Sentence Summary

The radio is not a job of “writing an FM protocol stack from scratch”:
On this device the Marlin2 chip’s FM component + the marlin_fm.ko driver are already running out of the box (/dev/fm is also already registered in /proc/misc),
so the real work is concentrated in three things — writing an FM daemon mirroring the bt_user_daemon pattern that wraps ioctls into socket commands,
drawing the radio page on the 31px line-height grid, and doing a good job on the FM / A2DP / local playback channel arbitration.
Before starting, complete the three pending verification items marked in §1.2, especially “whether headphones must be plugged in as the antenna” and the true semantics of OVER_BT_ENABLE.

entry.title: DMA支持與安卓移植可行性勘察
entry.content:
DMA 支持情況 & 從安卓移植的可行性勘察

  • 日期：2026-09-23
  • 問題：本機 DMA 到底支不支持？能不能把安卓那套音頻搬過來？
  • 結論：DMA 硬件與驅動都在，但內核層沒有可移植的東西（Alpine 跑的就是原廠安卓內核）；
    用戶態能搬的都試了，全無效。堵點已定位到 12 個音頻電源域全部 disabled、codec 數字部分寄存器讀出來全是 0。

1. 先糾正一個前提：Alpine 跑的就是原廠安卓內核

內核版本、編譯時間、androidboot.hardware=sc9832 都指向廠商原廠內核，
boot 分區 mmcblk0p16 頭部是標準 ANDROID! boot.img 魔數。

所以「從安卓移植驅動」這個方向不成立 —— 驅動本來就在這顆內核裡，而且全部是 builtin
（Android 側 /mnt/android_sys/lib/modules/ 裡只有 sprdwl.ko / marlin_fm.ko / mali.ko / gator.ko / autotst.ko / mmc_test.ko，沒有任何音頻模塊）。

2. DMA 支持情況：硬件和驅動都在

項狀態
/sys/class/dma不存在 —— 但這是正常的：sprd 用的是自家 DMA 驅動，沒走內核 dmaengine 框架
0.dma-controller / 0.dmac存在（platform device）
sprd_dma_copy.27存在
i2s.38 / .39 / .40 / .41存在
sprd-pcm-audio.42、sprd-codec.34存在
vbc-r2p0.36、vaudio.37、saudio_lte.0、saudio_voip.1存在
sprd-audio-power.1 ~ .1212 個音頻電源域，均帶 regulator 子目錄
regulator framework / sc2723-regulator正常，共 38 個 regulator

結論：DMA 不是缺驅動，也不是缺硬件。

3. 從安卓搬了什麼、結果如何

可搬項來源結果
audio_para/mnt/android_sys/etc/audio_para（485KB），HAL 字符串裡明確有 /etc/audio_para 和 /data/local/media/audio_para❌ 無效。已放到 /etc/audio_para + /lib/firmware/audio_para 並重啟，codec 數字部分寄存器仍全是 0
音頻 HAL/mnt/android_sys/lib/hw/audio.primary.sc8830.so❌ 它是 bionic 動態庫，本機是 musl，跑不起來。不過它裡面的控件序列我們早先已還原並實測過（見 §5）
tinyplay / tinycap / tinymix/mnt/android_sys/bin/❌ 同樣是 bionic 二進制。等價功能已用自寫工具（fm_cap_scan / fm_play_probe）覆蓋
VBC 通路HAL 用 /dev/vbpipe6、/dev/pipe/mmi.audio.ctrl❌ 本機 /dev/vbpipe* 和 /dev/pipe 都不存在
AGDSP / 音頻 DSP—❌ sipc 只有 sipc-lte(dst 0x5) 和 sipc-pmsys(dst 0x6)，沒有任何 audio DSP 通道；/sys/kernel/debug/sipc/ 下是 sblock/sbuf/seblock/sipx/smem/smsg，但 smsg 通道列表裡只有 lte/pmsys

4. 堵點定位（本次最重要的發現）

4.1 codec 數字部分寄存器讀出來全是 0

/proc/asound/sprdphone/sprd-codec 可以直接 dump 寄存器：

模擬部分（走 SC2723 的 ADI 總線）正常，數字部分是空的。
放 audio_para + 重啟之後依然全 0。

4.2 12 個音頻電源域全部沒人用

全部 disabled，users=0。DAPM 裡 Analog Power / DA Clk / AD Clk 那批 Off 的 widget，
對應的就是這些電源域。

/sys/class/regulator/regulator.X/ 下只有 device name num_users power subsystem suspend_* type uevent，沒有可寫的 state → 用戶態無法強制 enable，必須由內核 DAPM 去做。

4.3 完整因果鏈

5. 已經試過、不要再重複的動作

  • 按廠商 tiny_hw.xml 配齊 digital-fm + speaker 完整通路，並用 fm_hold 保持 hw:1,4 running
    → bias_level 仍 Off、ON widget 數為 0
  • 放 audio_para 到 /etc 和 /lib/firmware 並重啟 → 無效
  • unbind/bind 重新 probe sprd-codec.34 → bind 失敗，codec 變成 (null)，
    只能靠重啟恢復。    不要再對 sprd-codec.34 做 unbind    ，會把音頻子系統搞壞

6. 還能做什麼

  1. 需要廠商內核源碼才能繼續：查 sprd-codec 的 probe / set_bias_level 為什麼沒把 bias 拉到
    STANDBY、數字寄存器為什麼訪問不到。本機 /tmp/linux-3.10.65 是 vanilla 樹，不含廠商代碼。
  2. 次優：用 dynamic_debug 打開 sprd-codec / snd_soc 的 dapm 與 bias 相關打印，
    能看到 DAPM 決策過程（不需要源碼也能拿到一些信息）。
  3. 不推薦的方向：繼續在用戶態調 kcontrol —— 電源域 enable 不了，控件怎麼設都沒用。

7. 現場狀態（勘察後）

  • 設備已重啟一次，一切正常：lvgl_demo / bt_user_daemon(1177) / fm_user_daemon(1228) / lvgl_watchdog 均在跑
  • /etc/audio_para 與 /lib/firmware/audio_para 已部署（實測無效，留著無害）
  • 重啟後 kcontrol 已回到默認值（此前配的 digital-fm / speaker 組合已清空）
  • 新增工具：/root/fm_cap_scan（採集矩陣掃描）、/root/fm_play_probe（播放矩陣，非阻塞）、
    /root/fm_hold（保持 PCM running）

版權聲明：本文為 whiteleibniz 原創文章（AI 協作整理），版權歸 whiteleibniz 所有，轉載請註明出處與原文鏈接：https://whiteleibniz.github.io

entry.title: FM上電_腳本說明
entry.content:
FM 射頻上電腳本

日期：2026-09-23　設備 <設備IP>（Alpine / SC9832A / Marlin2 combo）
背景：zz_fm.start 以前只把 fm_user_daemon 拉起來，**從來沒發過 on**，
於是開機後呈現”daemon 在、chipid=0x2341 正常，但射頻 off“的假可用狀態。

1. 上電鏈（缺一不可）

任何一環缺失的表現都是 ioctl -110（set_marlin_wakeup ack timeout）。

2. 三個腳本

文件作用
/root/fm_powerup.sh射頻上電，冪等。用法 sh /root/fm_powerup.sh [freq_kHz] [vol]，默認 97400 5
/etc/local.d/zz_fm.start開機自啟：起 daemon → 調 fm_powerup.sh → 拉起保活
/root/fm_watchdog.sh每 5s 檢查 daemon，掉了就重啟 daemon 並異步補一次上電

fm_powerup.sh 內部流程

  1. 前置校驗：wcnd 在跑、/dev/fm 存在（否則 FATAL 退出並提示先跑 bt_bringup）
  2. daemon 不在則拉起；輪詢等待 /tmp/fm_ctl.sock 出現（最多 30s）
  3. 讀 state，已是 on 則跳過；否則發 on，最多重試 3 次
    —— 失敗時重啟 daemon 重建 @wcnd 的 FM-OPEN 長連接再試（這是 -110 的標準治法）
  4. 成功後置 tune / vol / mute 0，打印最終 state
  5. 日誌同時寫 /var/log/fm_boot.log

注意：腳本刻意不調用 rssi——該 ioctl 每次固定阻塞約 4.2s 後超時。
socket 交互統一走帶 settimeout(6) 的 python，避免把腳本掛死。

3. 實測結果（2026-09-23）

保活：pid=30867，再次執行腳本會自行 exit 0（pid 文件單實例生效）。

4. 順帶修掉的漏洞

fm_watchdog.sh 以前沒人負責拉起（全盤 grep 只在它自己的文件裡命中自身名字），
即 daemon 一旦掛掉就再不自愈。現由 zz_fm.start 末尾拉起，且重啟後會異步補上電。

5. 踩到的坑

用 ps -o pid,args | grep '[f]m_watchdog.sh' 判活會誤判為”已在跑”——
它命中了承載這條命令的 sh -c 進程本身（PID 29166）。
[f] 寫法只能避開 grep 自己，避不開外殼的 sh -c。
shell 腳本單實例一律用 pid 文件 + kill -0 判定。

6. 已知副作用

FM 射頻上電後內核會持續刷 (FM_RDS) / FM_DRV 日誌並推高 load（約 9 行/秒），
調試其它內核問題時先 python3 /root/fm_cli.py off 關掉射頻。

版權聲明：本文為 whiteleibniz 原創文章（AI 協作整理），版權歸 whiteleibniz 所有，轉載請註明出處與原文鏈接：https://whiteleibniz.github.io

entry.title: FM收音_SEEK與場強_實測結論
entry.content:
FM 收音 —— SEEK / 場強 / AT 文本直寫 實測結論

設備：展訊 SC9832A（Alpine Linux / armv7l），FM 芯片 Unisoc Marlin2 combo，
驅動 marlin_fm.ko，節點 /dev/fm，ioctl 統一 _IOWR(0xF5, nr, 4) = 0xC004F500 | nr。
實測時間：2026-09-22。全部結論均為設備實測，判真器是驅動自己的 dmesg（fm_write_buf / parse_at_fm_cmd）。

0. 一句話結論

想做的事能不能原因
上電 / 調臺 / 音量 / 靜音✅POWER_UP(0x00) / TUNE(0x02) / SETVOL(0x04) / MUTE(0x06) 真發 SDIO
搜臺（下一個電臺）❌SEEK(0x03) 的起點頻率被驅動截斷成 1 字節，帶內頻點傳不進去；實測只有 2 個固定回值
讀信號場強❌唯一真發 SDIO 的 GETRSSI(0x07) 恆超時 4.2s 且回值幾乎不變；其餘信號類命令全是空殼
寫 AT 文本繞開 ioctl❌write(/dev/fm) 恆定 -1 / EINVAL(22)，驅動不接收用戶態 AT 文本

1. SEEK (0x03) —— 參數被截斷，無法用來搜臺

1.1 參數結構（與 TUNE 相同）

1.2 驅動實際發出的 AT 幀

驅動把 freq（u16）只取低字節拼進 AT 幀（這是驅動的 bug）：

我們傳 freq驅動實際發出芯片回幀驅動回寫到 tail[0..1] 的”找到頻點”
974 (97.4MHz)at+fm=4,0,2063,139,0,9250925 = 92.5MHz
875 (87.5MHz)at+fm=4,0,1073,139,0,9250925
1080 (108.0MHz)at+fm=4,0,563,139,0,9250925
900、1000at+fm=4,0,132 / ,2323,139,0,9250925
0at+fm=4,0,03,139,0,103101031 = 103.1MHz
  • at+fm=4,<p2>,<p3> 的 p2 恆為 0：把 zero/band/one/pad 都改成 1/2 也不變。
  • **p3 = freq & 0xFF**，所以帶內頻點（875~1080）永遠傳不進去。
  • 結果與”當前頻點”無關：先 TUNE 到 87.5 / 97.4 / 100.0 / 103.1，再 SEEK(0)，
    四次都回 103.1。

1.3 行為模型

  • p3 == 0 → 恆返回 92.5MHz 區間的另一極（103.1MHz）
  • p3 != 0 → 恆返回 92.5MHz

也就是說 SEEK 退化成”兩個固定值二選一”，不是”從當前頻點向上/向下找下一個電臺”。
UI 上不要把它做成”搜臺”按鈕。

  • 耗時：每次約 1.43 s（at+fm=4 發出 → parse_at_fm_cmd: fm seek event have come freq=...）。
  • 驅動日誌裡那句 FM seek freq =0 裡的值恆為 0，與傳入的 freq 無關 → 別拿它當判據。
  • SEEK_NEW(0x3d) 只打日誌後發 at+fm=12（通用查詢幀），SCAN(0x08) / SCAN_NEW(0x3c)
    返回 0 且零 SDIO 流量 → 都是空殼/佔位。
  • STOP_SCAN(0x09) 恆 -1 / EINVAL(22)。

1.4 探針

  • ssh_tools/fm_seek_probe.c + fm_seek_probe_run.py —— 參數變體矩陣 + 回寫結構體 dump
  • ssh_tools/fm_seek_probe2.c + fm_seek_probe2_run.py —— 起點/方向語義驗證（配合 TUNE）

2. write(/dev/fm) 寫 AT 文本 —— 被內核拒絕

驅動裡有 parse_at_fm_cmd / parse_at_fm_num，Android 側 libengfm.so 也只導出
一個 fm_runcommand，看起來像”可以直接寫 AT 文本繞開 ioctl”。實測不行：

dmesg 中沒有任何 fm_write_buf 記錄 → 請求在進入驅動前就被拒了，沒有 SDIO 流量。
結論：此路不通，不要在這上面花時間。 探針：ssh_tools/fm_at_probe.c + fm_at_probe_run.py。

3. 場強 / 信號類命令 —— 全部不可用

命令命令號實測判定
GETRSSI0x07唯一真發 SDIO（at+fm=13），芯片回 123~125，但 ioctl 恆 -1 / ETIMEDOUT(110)，耗時恆 4.2s；10 個頻點上回值幾乎不變 → 不能當場強表
SCAN_GETRSSI0x24空殼（只 printk）
CQI_GET0x27空殼
GETMONOSTERO0x0d空殼
GETGOODBCNT / GETBADBNT0x0f / 0x10空殼
GETBLERRATIO0x11空殼
IS_DESE_CHAN0x2a空殼
SOFT_MUTE_TUNE0x3f有作用（換臺消爆音），但不回寫可用場強

TUNE 應答裡的第 2 個字段不是場強：at+fm=1,9740 → 0,164,0,9740；
同一頻點連調會得到 164 與 139 兩個不同值；不同頻點都在 139~140 附近；
且驅動根本不把這個應答回寫給用戶態（ioctl 返回後 arg 結構體沒變化）。
→ 判定：不是穩定的場強指標，不能當信號表。

下游影響：收音機頁不應再畫”信號柱”。
現版本已改為固定文案「本機不提供場強查詢」，並移除了每次調臺後的
rssi 輪詢（原來每次白等 4.2s）。

4. 相關：FM 音頻輸出也是死的

見 FM收音ioctl命令表_逆向還原.md 與 outputs/FM收音機_進度快照_20260922.md：

  • FM 音頻類 ioctl（OVER_BT_ENABLE 0x1d / ANA_SWITCH 0x1e / I2S_SETTING 0x21 …）
    在 marlin_fm.ko 裡只 printk 就返回（反彙編 fm_ioctl 的 R_ARM_CALL 只調 7 個函數，無音頻通路函數）。
  • 整機 codec（sprdphone card1）DAPM 路由表缺 HPL/HPR/SPKL/SPKR，
    唯一可達終點是 EAR，且從不給 Analog/Digital Power 上電（bias_level=Off 恆 Off）。
  • 8 個 capture 設備**全部 readi -5 (EIO)**；read(/dev/fm) 只返回 688B RDS 數據塊。
    → FM 音頻既不能出聲，也不能數字化進主機。用戶態無解。

5. 對應用設計的約束（可直接抄）

  1. UI 不要提供”搜臺”按鈕 —— SEEK 不可控，會讓人以為搜到了電臺。
  2. UI 不要畫信號強度 —— 硬件不提供；畫了就是說謊。
  3. 不要輪詢 rssi —— 每次白等 4.2s。
  4. 不要嘗試寫 AT 文本 —— EINVAL。
  5. 可用且已驗證的功能集：state / on / off / tune <kHz> / vol <0-15> / mute <0|1> / chipid / rds。
  6. 任何”要不要為此改內核”的決策，都先看本文第 4 節 —— 出聲的瓶頸在 codec 的 DAPM 路由，
    不在 FM 驅動。

版權聲明：本文為 whiteleibniz 原創文章（AI 協作整理），版權歸 whiteleibniz 所有，轉載請註明出處與原文鏈接：https://whiteleibniz.github.io

entry.title: FM出聲_廠商官方音頻通路與實操步驟
entry.content:
FM 出聲：廠商官方音頻通路（2026-09-23）

背景：本機 FM「應用層已通」（TUNE / RDS / 音量都有），唯獨沒有聲音。
先前結論是「FM 音頻在用戶態不可行」，理由是：card1 DAPM 路由不完整、8 個 capture 全 EIO、
codec_reg 是空文件。
本次推翻該結論的一半：FM 音頻並非只能靠 marlin_fm.ko 裡的那幾個音頻 ioctl ——
廠商其實已經把 FM 音頻通路寫進了 Android 分區的配置文件裡，而且
本機 card1 上這些 kcontrol 全部存在。
之前沒出來，是因為從來沒人按那份配置去設過。

狀態：待你在設備上手動驗證（我不再跑驗證）。本文檔給出控件名、順序、命令、排錯要點。

1. 先說結論

項結論
OVER_BT_ENABLE(0x1d) / I2S_SETTING(0x21) / ANA_SWITCH(0x1e) / GET_AUDIO_INFO(0x30)本機 marlin_fm.ko 裡是空殼：fm_ioctl 進 case 只 printk 一行名字就返回，不發任何 SDIO 命令（反彙編已確認）。不要再指望用 FM ioctl 切音頻通路。
上游開源驅動（同一份 marlin2_fm）同樣把這幾個 case 寫成 ret = 0; break;——廠商從來沒在這條鏈路上實現。這是 OVER_BT_ENABLE 這條路已死的權威證據。
真正的通路在哪在 AP codec 側，廠商在 Android system 分區 /etc/tiny_hw.xml 裡給了完整定義。FM 芯片出來的音頻（數字 DIGFM 或模擬 AIL/AIR line-in）→ codec → SPK/耳機，AP 不需要搬音頻數據。
本機是否具備具備。card1（sprdphone）裡 Digital FM Function、AD IISMUX（enum 含 DIGFM）、Line Function、ADCL/ADCR Mixer AILADCL/AIRADCR、SPKL Mixer ADCLSPKL、HPL Mixer ADCRHPL 等控件全部存在。
為什麼之前沒出來先前只設了 Speaker Function（把 DACL→EAR 打通），沒設 FM 側的任何一個控件，也沒有打開 hw:1,4(Dfm) PCM 去觸發 DAPM 上電。兩件事都沒做，自然沒聲。

2. 廠商官方 path 定義（原文）

來源：設備 Android system 分區 /etc/tiny_hw.xml（只讀掛載在 /mnt/android_sys）。

2.1 數字 FM —— <device name="digital-fm">

AD IISMUX 的 enum 選項（本機 card1 實測）：
[0]=AUDIIS0 [1]=DIGFM [2]=EXTDIGFM [3]=EXTIIS6 [4]=AUDIIS1

⚠️ 注意：本機 dump 出來的 enum 順序是 (AUDIIS0/DIGFM/EXTDIGFM/EXTIIS6/AUDIIS1)，
val="2" 在這個順序裡落在 EXTDIGFM 而不是 DIGFM。XML 是給另一份 kernel/codec 版本寫的，
兩個值都要試（建議先 2，再 1）。這是本方案裡最可能需要現場調的一個值。

2.2 模擬 FM（line-in → codec loop）

2.3 輸出側（數字 FM 也要配一個）

參考：SC9832A 平臺同款 SoC 的公開分析確認 FM 音頻從 codec 的 AIL/AIR（類似 MIC 的 line-in）進
codec，再「FM playback patch」直出，或經 VBC 給主控錄音——與上面的配置文件完全對得上。

3. 你怎麼跑（手動驗證步驟）

3.0 準備

  1. FM 上電鏈先起來：WiFi 固件下載 → bt_bringup.start（含 wcn BT-OPEN）→ 向 @wcnd 發 wcn FM-OPEN
    並長期保持連接。
  2. fm_user_daemon 常開 /dev/fm（socket /tmp/fm_ctl.sock），TUNE 到一個本地強信號電臺。
  3. 通過 /tmp/fm_ctl.sock 執行 mute 0，確認 FM 未處於靜音（socket 命令寫法見
    AI工作流/*/docs/ 與 lv_pages/radio_page.c）。
  4. 沒有 amixer/tinymix，用已有的 /root/fm_ctl：fm_ctl <op> <card> ...

3.1 先確認控件真名（非常重要）

之前 dump 出來的名字不一定等於 ALSA 全名（例如 dump 裡是 ADCL Mixer AILADCL，
XML 裡是 ADCL Mixer AILADCL Switch）。先 grep 一次拿真名：

3.2 方案 A：數字 FM → 揚聲器（推薦先試）

第 3 步是最容易漏的一步：Dfm 這個 PCM 設備存在的意義就是「開流把 DAPM 拉起來」，
只設 kcontrol 而 stream 沒起來，bias_level 會一直停在 Off（這正是之前觀察到的現象）。

3.3 方案 B：模擬 line-in → 揚聲器 / 耳機

3.4 關 / 復位

4. 排錯要點

現象可能原因處理
完全無聲，bias_level 仍 Offhw:1,4 沒被打開/寫入確認 fm_pcm 進程在跑且 writei 沒返回錯誤
有聲但很小 / 失真走的是 line-in 模擬通路，增益沒配只保留一條 route（兩條同時開會互相串擾），並換另一個 AD IISMUX 取值再試
AD IISMUX 設不動enum 值範圍不同先 fm_ctl get card1 "AD IISMUX" 看允許的取值範圍
需要插耳機FM 天線可能掛在耳機線上不插耳機 TUNE 到最強臺再試；若必須插，UI 要有提示
數字 FM 一直不成本機固件可能沒把 FM 數字口接到 VBC退回方案 B（模擬 line-in），這條路最好 route 完整

沿用「末端證據」原則：判斷標準是人耳聽到電臺聲，不是 ioctl 返回 0。

5. 待確認清單（驗證後回填）

  • AD IISMUX 正確取值（1 / 2 / 3 哪個是 DIGFM）
  • 數字 FM 與模擬 line-in 哪條在本機真的通
  • 是否需要插耳機當天線
  • 音量到底歸 SETVOL(0x04) 管還是歸 codec 的 pga（codec_pga.xml 裡 digital-fm profile 用 VBC STL DG Set / VBC STR DG Set）
  • FM 與 A2DP 同時開時的串擾情況（決定聲道仲裁怎麼寫）

6. 附：證據來源

文件內容
/mnt/android_sys/etc/tiny_hw.xml廠商 mixer path 全量定義（本文 §2 原文出處）
/mnt/android_sys/etc/codec_pga.xmldigital-fm profile → VBC STL DG Set(bit 0) / VBC STR DG Set(bit 16)
radio_docs/mixer_card1.txt本機 card1 全部 kcontrol dump（確認控件存在）
LKML [PATCH 2/2] misc: added Spreadtrum's radio driver（Chunyan Zhang, 2017）驅動上游源碼：FM_IOCTL_* 全表、chip 側 FM_*_CMD 編號、以及 I2S/AudioInfo case 是空實現
公開分析《Sprd 9832A Android6.0 FM 模式下的幾種 Audio 路徑》AIL/AIR 輸入、三種模式（Line_in-Codec / Line_in-VBC-Codec / Digital FM-VBC-Codec）的信號流

版權聲明：本文為 whiteleibniz 原創文章（AI 協作整理），版權歸 whiteleibniz 所有，轉載請註明出處與原文鏈接：https://whiteleibniz.github.io

entry.title: FM出聲_藍牙路線實測驗證結論
entry.content:
FM 出聲 —— 藍牙（A2DP）路線實測驗證結論

  • 日期：2026-09-23
  • 目標：本機無耳機孔，把 FM 音頻數字化後寫進 /tmp/bt_audio.fifo，經藍牙 A2DP 送到小愛音箱
  • 結論：用戶態不可行。三條子路線全部實測封死，且根因不在 FM，而在整個 AP 音頻子系統不上電
  • 驗證方式：全部由我上機實跑（用戶要求「你直接幫我驗證」），證據見 §3

1. 路線拆解

要讓小愛音箱出 FM 的聲音，必須湊齊兩個條件：

條件 B 已經通了（09-23 上午驗證過：灌 8.6MB 靜音 PCM，鏈路 49s 不掉、HCI credit 持續變化）。
條件 A 是死結，本文驗證的就是它，以及它的三條候選實現。

路線做法結果
A1codec 模擬輸入（AIL/AIR）→ capture PCM 讀出來❌ readi 恆 -5 (EIO)
A2數字 FM（AD IISMUX=DIGFM）→ capture PCM 讀出來❌ 同上，且配與不配結果完全一致
A3combo 芯片內部 FM→BT 直通（用戶選的 b 路線）❌ 見 §3.4，驅動與協議棧兩側都沒這個能力

2. 本次新寫/新編的工具

工具作用
ssh_tools/fm_cap_scan.c → /root/fm_cap_scan一次掃完所有 capture 設備 × 採樣率 × 聲道，報告 nonzero / rms / peak
ssh_tools/fm_play_probe.c → /root/fm_play_probe同樣方式掃 playback，判定 DMA 到底動不動
ssh_tools/fm_hold.c → /root/fm_hold保持某個 playback PCM 處於 running，用來觸發 DAPM 上電

★ 編譯坑（必記）：本機沒有 alsa 頭文件（/usr/include/alsa 不存在），
#include <alsa/asoundlib.h> 直接編不過。必須照 fm_ctl.c 的套路走 dlopen("libasound.so.2")
取符號，命令是 gcc -O2 -o xxx xxx.c -ldl -lm（不是 -lasound）。
我之前寫 fm_pcm.c 時踩過一次，這次三個工具全部改用 dlopen 版。

★ 第二個坑：playback 必須用 非阻塞 打開。第一次用阻塞模式跑矩陣，hw:1,4
的 writei 永久卡死，整個矩陣被第一個組合拖到超時，什麼數據都沒拿到。

3. 實測證據

3.1 所有 capture PCM 一律 EIO（配控件前後都一樣）

不配任何控件、配數字 FM 通路、配 line-in 通路，三種情況下跑 fm_cap_scan，結果完全相同：

關鍵對照：card0 是 i2s.X null-codec-dai（跟 FM 毫無關係的空 codec），
它的 capture **同樣是 -5 EIO**。

這一條推翻了「FM 音頻進不了主機」的說法 ——
不是 FM 的問題，是整個 AP 音頻採集通路都不工作。

3.2 播放側：DMA 啟動一下就停，硬件指針不前進

fm_play_probe（非阻塞）結果：

讀法很重要：**frames=9600 說明 writei 一開始是成功的**（9600 幀 = 200ms 緩衝，
正好填滿整個 ring buffer），之後才 -11 (EAGAIN)。

即：PCM start 了，數據進了 ring buffer，但 DMA 從不搬運，硬件指針不前進。
這與 capture 側 EIO 是同一個根因的兩面。

3.3 DAPM 永遠不上電（決定性證據）

用 fm_hold 保持 hw:1,4 running，同時按廠商 tiny_hw.xml 配齊完整通路：

然後查 DAPM：

這是最硬的一條證據：in=1 說明 DAPM 的連接關係是通的（正如此前”路由通了”的觀察），
但 bias_level=Off、所有 widget 全 Off —— codec 從頭到尾沒上過電。
沒有上電，DAC 不出聲、ADC 不採樣，capture 自然 EIO。

3.4 藍牙直通（b 路線）也是死的

  • 驅動側：marlin_fm.ko 裡 OVER_BT_ENABLE(0x1d) / ANA_SWITCH(0x1e) /
    I2S_SETTING(0x21) / GET_AUDIO_INFO(0x30) 全是空殼（進 case 只 printk 名字）。
    更硬的證據是上游同源驅動（LKML 2017 展訊 marlin2_fm 補丁）裡這幾個 case 寫的就是
    ret = 0; break; —— 展訊壓根沒實現，不是我們這版被裁掉。
  • 協議棧側：strings /usr/local/bin/bt_user_daemon | grep -i 'fm' 一個 FM 相關串都沒有，
    只有 [TX] opcode=0x%04x ...。自研協議棧不認識 FM，沒有 FM 直通入口。
  • 繞過驅動的口子也不存在：dmesg 裡能看到內核自己發 mdbg_proc->write_buf:at+loopcheck，
    但 /dev/mdbg* 不存在，那是內核內部通道，用戶態夠不著；
    write(/dev/fm, "at+fm=...") 恆 EINVAL。

3.5 順帶排除的假設

假設排查結果
缺 audio_para 導致 codec 初始化不全Android 分區裡有 /etc/audio_para（485KB），但 codec kcontrol 全部正常註冊（120 個），說明 probe 是成功的，不是參數缺失
AGDSP 固件沒加載sipc 只暴露了 spipe_lte0~14（LTE modem 通道），沒有任何音頻 DSP 通道；sysfs 裡只有 saudio_lte.0 / saudio_voip.1（都是給 LTE/voip 的共享內存音頻），沒有 AGDSP 的 saudio 通道。固件就算有也無從加載
固件裡有隱藏的 FM 音頻路由 AT 命令wcnmodem 分區 dump 裡只有 marlin_fm_ctrl.c、Handle_FM_RX_CMD_ENABLE、fm_cfg 0x%x,%x,%x、marlin_fm_seek_* 等少量串，沒有 at+fm 命令族、沒有 over_bt 相關串

4. 根因判斷

所以：這不是”FM 音頻沒接進來”，而是”這臺機器在 Alpine 下整個音頻子系統是死的”。
這也解釋了此前所有”路由通了但就是沒聲音”的觀察。

5. 結論與剩餘選項

用戶態（當前內核）：FM 經藍牙出聲 —— 不可行，三條子路線已全部實測封死。

要走通只剩動內核（原方案 a），且要動的地方比預想的多：

  1. 設備樹 / sipc 配置裡補上 AGDSP 音頻通道（當前只有 LTE 通道）；
  2. 把 AGDSP 固件加載起來（需先確認固件在哪個分區，當前 /proc/partitions 裡沒有明確命名的 dsp 分區）；
  3. 確認 codec 的 set_bias_level 具體卡在哪一步（可用 dynamic_debug 打開 sprd-codec 的
    dapm / bias 相關打印來定位）。

這三項都需要內核源碼（本機 /tmp/linux-3.10.65 是 vanilla 樹，不含廠商代碼），
且重新編譯內核後要能刷機。請確認手上有沒有廠商內核源碼樹，沒有的話這條路也走不動。

可以立刻做的、不需要內核的退路：FM 功能保留為 UI 可演示（調頻、RDS、搜臺的替代交互），
出聲這塊如實標註”本機音頻子系統不可用”。

6. 現場狀態（驗證後留在設備上的）

  • 控件目前配置在「數字 FM + Speaker 輸出」狀態（Digital FM Function=1、AD IISMUX=2、
    Speaker Function=1、SPKL Mixer DACLSPKL=1、SPKR Mixer DACRSPKR=1）
  • FM daemon 已上電、TUNE 在 97.4MHz、mute=0
  • /root/fm_hold 可能仍在後臺佔著 hw:1,4（最多 170s 後自行退出）。
    要再跑一次 fm_cap_scan / fm_play_probe，先 kill 掉它，否則會 Resource busy
