entry.title: FM Radio_Progress Snapshot_20260922
entry.content:
FM Radio — Progress Snapshot (2026-09-22)

Scope: Unisoc SC9832A / Alpine Linux / armv7l / 720×1280 portrait screen / LVGL 9.6.0
This article only covers exactly how far the implementation has gone: what can run, what has been accepted, what has been disproved by measurement, and what remains.

I. Conclusion in One Sentence

The FM application layer is complete and working: daemon + radio page + desktop entry + boot autostart, with the entire chain reproducible and acceptable via screenshots.
The only thing that cannot be solved in user space is “making sound” — FM audio flows in hardware only to the FM chip’s own analog output,
entering neither the system codec nor the host capture, so it can neither be played through the speaker nor digitized and fed to Bluetooth.

II. Completed and Accepted (All Measured on the Device)

2.1 FM Daemon — 100% Complete (Commands Available on This Device)

/usr/local/bin/fm_user_daemon (19784 B) on the device, with boot autostart, single instance, and resident operation.

CapabilityImplementationMeasured result
Open the FM channelConnect to abstract unix socket @wcnd → send wcn FM-OPEN → keep the connection long-termwcn FM-OPEN -> WCNBTWIFI-CMD OK
/dev/fm handleKept open, never closed (close triggers fm_release → sends at+fm=12, blocking for ~4 s)Held at all times
Channel self-healingA 5 s watchdog period; the channel is automatically reopened when it dropsImplemented
Control protocolunix socket /tmp/fm_ctl.sock, plain-text single-line commandsSee the table below
Command timeout protectionSO_SNDTIMEO/SO_RCVTIMEO, with replies written using MSG_NOSIGNAL + ignoring SIGPIPEFixed (see §3.3)

Protocol and measured receipts:

chipid=0x2341 and rds=1 are values genuinely read back from the chip, proving that the entire SDIO channel is alive.

2.2 LVGL Radio Page — 100% Complete (All 8 Zones Render Correctly)

lv_pages/radio_page.c (34287 B) on the device. It has passed manual zone-by-zone proofreading using screenshots.

Key engineering points (all pitfalls encountered and already fixed):

  1. The UI thread must never do socket I/O — a dedicated IO thread rp_io_worker() runs blocking commands,
    while the LVGL timer rp_poll_cb() (700 ms) only does a locked memcpy + control refresh.
    Reason: a single rssi call takes 4 s, and calling it directly on the UI thread would freeze the interface.
  2. The ruler width must not be queried from LVGL — lv_obj_get_width() returns the cached coords (= 0) during the onCreate stage,
    and after being defaulted to 10, all ticks are squeezed to the far left. This was changed to a self-cached width rp_ruler_width() + a fallback value.
  3. The ruler pointer must not be attached under a parent object that will be cleaned — it was originally attached under marks,
    and the lv_obj_clean(marks) in rebuild() would delete the pointer along with it. It was reattached under card.
  4. Inset the two ends of the scale — full-width mapping pushes the 108 label and the 87.5 red square out of the visible area.
  5. Lifecycle: onPause only stops UI polling and never stops FM (returning to the desktop must continue playback);
    onDestroy only clears its own handles and does not delete root (it is deleted uniformly by the page manager).

2.3 Page Entry / Return — Closed-Loop Acceptance Achieved This Round

Screenshots: shots/re_0.png (desktop, focus box on the radio), shots/re_1.png (radio page),
shots/re_on.png (radio page after FM power-up), shots/re_after_back.png (desktop after returning).

⚠️ The earlier “cannot enter the page” was my own operational mistake, not a program defect:
LAUNCHER_APP_RADIO is inserted at index 8 in the app table (settings/network/Bluetooth/radio/gallery),
and the initial focus at startup is index 8 = the radio. My earlier key sequence Down→Right→Right→Right→Confirm instead moved the focus away.
Correct operation: press “Confirm” directly on the desktop to enter the radio page.

2.4 Desktop Entry — 100% Complete

  • Added { LAUNCHER_APP_RADIO, "收音机", LV_SYMBOL_VOLUME_MAX, 0xe6614f } to s_apps[] (row 2, column 4, after Bluetooth).
  • The icon uses LV_SYMBOL_VOLUME_MAX (speaker).
    Measurement showed that among the 60 FontAwesome icons in this device’s lv_font_cn_16, there is no “station/antenna/radio wave” glyph at all
    (F519/F2CE/F7C0/F8CE/F09E/F130 all render as tofu boxes), so the speaker was used as a fallback.
  • Added case LAUNCHER_APP_RADIO: → lv_start_activity(&g_radio_page, ...) to launcher_open_app().

2.5 Boot Autostart — 100% Complete, Verified by Measurement

/etc/local.d/zz_fm.start (1172 B): wait for bt_user_daemon for up to 180 s (indicating the WCN chain is ready) →
kill old instances → clear the socket → start with setsid → after 6 s, report the instance count/socket/log.
Measured after a device cold start: fm_user_daemon comes up automatically, with chipid=0x2341 rds=1.

III. Old Conclusions Corrected This Round (Important; Do Not Follow the Old Ones)

3.1 “Audio-type ioctls Can Configure an Audio Path” → They Are All Hollow Shells

OVER_BT_ENABLE 0x1D / ANA_SWITCH 0x1E / I2S_SETTING 0x21 / GET_I2S_INFO 0x29 / GET_AUDIO_INFO 0x30
only printk and return inside marlin_fm.ko, producing no SDIO traffic whatsoever.

Criterion (the hardest evidence on this device): after clearing dmesg and calling them, the driver only prints the command names,
with no fm_write_buf ... at+fm=xx SDIO send/receive appearing at all;
by contrast, POWER_UP / TUNE / GETRSSI print the complete send/receive pairs at+fm=1,9740 / at+fm=13.

General experience: to judge whether an ioctl is a hollow shell, look at whether it produces real lower-layer traffic, not at rc.

3.2 “Enabling Speaker per the Vendor’s tiny_hw.xml Will Produce Sound” → No Such Route Exists in the Kernel

The DAPM graph (137 widgets) has an incomplete topology by measurement:

  • The out of DACL Switch is only EAR Mixer; DACR Switch has no out;
  • HPL/HPR/SPKL/SPKR Mixer has zero inputs (completely isolated) → going through the speaker is physically impossible;
  • The only reachable output endpoint on the whole device is EAR (the earpiece).

Even if kcontrols such as Earpiece Function are turned on according to the real path (the DAC→EAR in count measured 0→2, the chain is connected),
the whole-device codec is still all Off, with bias_level=Off — connected, but not powered.

3.3 “The daemon is stable” → It Once Exited Silently Due to SIGPIPE; Fixed

When the client (radio page) disconnects first, a bare write() in the daemon triggers SIGPIPE,
whose default action is to terminate the process → the daemon dies silently. This has been changed to MSG_NOSIGNAL + signal(SIGPIPE, SIG_IGN).

3.4 “SEEK/SCAN Are Usable and Can Search for Stations” → SEEK Parameters Are Truncated and SCAN Is a Hollow Shell (new this round)

  • SEEK (0x03) really does send SDIO, but the driver takes only the low byte of the u16 starting frequency when assembling the AT frame
    (974 → at+fm=4,0,206) → in-band frequencies cannot be passed in; measurement showed only two fixed return values, 92.5 / 103.1,
    and they are unrelated to the current frequency → it cannot serve as “next station”.
  • SCAN(0x08) / SCAN_NEW(0x3c): they return 0 but with zero SDIO traffic.
  • write(/dev/fm, "at+fm=..."), intended to bypass the driver bug → always EINVAL(22), with no SDIO traffic.

For detailed data, see radio_docs/FM收音_SEEK与场强_实测结论.md.

3.5 “Signal Strength Can Be Read” → No Credible Field Strength Can Be Obtained (new this round)

GETRSSI(0x07) is the only signal-class command that really sends SDIO, but it always times out with ETIMEDOUT after 4.2 s,
and its return values barely change across 10 frequency points (123~125); the rest (SCAN_GETRSSI/CQI_GET/GETMONOSTERO/…) are all hollow shells;
the second field of the TUNE response (164/139) is not a stable indicator either, and the driver does not write it back to user space.
→ The radio page has removed the fake signal bars and now says “this device does not provide a field strength query”.

IV. Blockers and Infeasible Items (No Solution in User Space)

4.1 FM Making Sound — ❌ No Solution in User Space (Conclusion Final)

All three possible exits for FM audio have been excluded by measurement:

ExitMeasured result
① FM chip analog output → system codec → speaker/headphoneThe DAPM routing table lacks HPL/SPKL, and the only reachable endpoint is EAR; moreover, the system codec’s bias_level is permanently Off, and Analog/Digital Power are all Off
② OVER_BT_ENABLE / ANA_SWITCH / I2S_SETTING to switch pathsHollow-shell ioctl, with no SDIO traffic (§3.1)
③ Host capture recording + digitization then feeding Bluetooth A2DPAll 8 capture devices fail with readi -5 EIO (the 4 on card0 even return -524 ENODEV for set_params); read(/dev/fm) only returns 688 B RDS blocks, with no PCM

Root cause: FM audio flows in hardware only to the FM chip’s own analog output → speaker/headphone,
with no FM audio channel entering the AGDSP. Therefore it can neither make sound nor be taken over by digitization.

Additional confirmation: after FM power-up + opening Dfm (hw:1,4), recording capture again (the last combination) still yields EIO, and DAPM is still all Off.

Reaching this point requires (choose one of three, all beyond user space):

  • (a) Modify the kernel: add the sprd-codec DAPM route / fix the stream trigger events so the system codec powers up;
  • (b) Obtain the BT firmware’s “FM passthrough” entry (HCI vendor command);
  • (c) Request the new version of the bt_user_daemon source code (the version currently on the device is not the old copy in the local ref_src/).

4.2 Signal Strength Table — ❌ The Hardware Provides No Usable Query

This round scanned 10 frequency points + used a probe to dump the ioctl write-back structure, with the following conclusions:

  • GETRSSI (0x07): the only signal-class command that really asks the chip. The chip replies to at+fm=13 with a small integer (123~125),
    and the driver writes it into the first byte of the arg buffer;
    but the ioctl always takes a fixed 4.2 s and then returns -1 / ETIMEDOUT(110),
    and the value barely changes across 10 frequency points → it cannot be used as a signal table.
  • SCAN_GETRSSI 0x24, CQI_GET 0x27, GETMONOSTERO 0x0D, GETGOODBCNT 0x0F,
    GETBADBNT 0x10, GETBLERRATIO 0x11, IS_DESE_CHAN 0x2A: all are hollow shells (printk only, no SDIO traffic).
  • In the chip’s TUNE response 0,<X>,0,9740, the second field appears to correlate with the frequency (97.4→164, 87.5→139),
    but tuning the same frequency twice in a row yields 164 and 139 → it is not a stable field-strength indicator, and the driver does not write this response back to user space.
  • RDS: the data path is alive (688 B blocks can be read back), but measurement shows blk2=blk4=180 is constant and The PS is (empty)
    → no valid RDS station name can be received in the current environment.

So the line “Raw N (query timeout)” on the UI now truthfully reflects the hardware state,
but as a “signal table” it is meaningless. The rework has been completed in §5 (changed to fixed text + removed polling).

4.3 Station Search (SEEK) — ❌ Parameters Are Truncated by the Driver; Cannot Serve as “Next Station”

SEEK (0x03) really does send SDIO (at+fm=4,<p2>,<p3>, about 1.43 s each time, and it can obtain
fm seek event have come freq=...), but the parameters are broken:

Starting freq we passWhat the driver actually sendsChip response frame“Found frequency” written back by the driver
974 (97.4MHz)at+fm=4,0,2063,139,0,9250925 = 92.5MHz
875 / 1080 / 900 / 1000,0,107 / ,0,56 / ,0,132 / ,0,2323,139,0,9250925
0at+fm=4,0,03,139,0,103101031 = 103.1MHz
  • The driver takes only the low byte of the u16 freq when assembling the AT frame → in-band frequencies (875~1080) can never be passed in;
  • The second parameter of the AT frame is always 0 (changing zero/band/one/pad to 1/2 makes no difference);
  • The result is unrelated to the current frequency: first TUNE to 87.5 / 97.4 / 100.0 / 103.1, then SEEK(0), and all four return 103.1.

→ SEEK degenerates into “either 92.5 or 103.1”; it is not station search. The UI should not provide a “station search” button.

Two additional paths excluded:

  • SCAN(0x08) / SCAN_NEW(0x3c): they return 0 but with zero SDIO traffic (hollow shell); STOP_SCAN(0x09) always returns EINVAL(22).
  • write(/dev/fm, "at+fm=4,0,9740"), intended to write AT text directly to bypass the driver bug → always -1 / EINVAL(22),
    with no fm_write_buf in dmesg → the driver does not accept user-space AT text; this path does not work.

Forensics scripts: ssh_tools/fm_seek_probe.c / fm_seek_probe2.c / fm_at_probe.c (including _run.py).
For complete data, see AI工作流/05_收音机/docs/FM收音_SEEK与场强_实测结论.md.

V. Incomplete / To-Do (★ Latest status after the late-night continuation on 2026-09-22)

5.1 Completed This Round ✅

#ItemResult
5Added rotation to /tmp/btud_dbg.log✅ 129.9 MB → 65 KB, root partition 77% → 75%; installed busybox crond (runs /root/log_rotate.sh on the hour) + boot autostart /etc/local.d/zz_crond.start; measurement confirmed the log continues to grow normally and is not a sparse file
1Changed the UI signal-strength area to honest text✅ Removed the 5 fake signal bars and changed it to “Field strength: this device does not provide a field strength query”; screenshot shots/dep_1E.png accepted
2Removed the pointless rssi polling✅ Removed the want_rssi logic (which used to waste 4.2 s after every tuning); the rssi command is retained on the daemon side for experimentation
—The “audio path” text at the bottom✅ Changed to “Audio output: temporarily unavailable on this device (no usable path)”, and removed the ineffective “switch audio path” button (ANA_SWITCH is a hollow shell; keeping it would only mislead)
4System-wide volume control✅ Graceful degradation: on first probe, if tinymix does not exist, it is set to “unavailable”, and the warning appears only once (previously, every slider drag forked a shell that would inevitably return 127); the measured log grep -c 'Volume System' = 1
7Outdated comments in launcher_page.c✅ Corrected (index 8 is now the radio, not task management; behavior unchanged)
8radio_docs/ documentation✅ Added FM收音_SEEK与场强_实测结论.md; added §0.1 Important Corrections at the top of FM收音ioctl命令表_逆向还原.md (overturning the three old conclusions that “SCAN/SCAN_GETRSSI can draw a spectrum”, “SEEK can search for stations”, and “AT text can be written”)

Screenshots accepted this round

ScreenshotContent
shots/fin_0.pngDesktop: all 12 app icons are present, the “Radio” speaker icon renders normally, and the focus box (pink outline) lands right on “Radio” → directly confirming that s_apps[] index 8 = the radio
shots/dep_1E.png / shots/fin_1.pngThe radio page’s 8 zones are all correct; “Field strength: this device does not provide a field strength query” and “Audio output: temporarily unavailable on this device (no usable path)” are shown, with no fake signal bars and no ANA button

Final process state (measured on the device)
lvgl_demo 15468 + lvgl_watchdog 15681；fm_user_daemon 2491 + fm_watchdog 20199；
bt_user_daemon 1222、wcnd 1155、crond 20905（整点轮转）

5.2 Still Incomplete / Pending User Decision ⏳

#ItemPriorityDescription
AFM making soundBlocking (decision needed)No solution in user space; choose one of three paths: (a) modify the kernel to add the sprd-codec DAPM route / fix the stream trigger; (b) obtain the BT firmware’s “FM passthrough” entry (HCI vendor command); (c) accept that “FM is demonstrable in UI/control only, with no sound”
BRequest the new version of the bt_user_daemon source codeMediumNeeded if path (b) is taken
CCommit the source code into the repositoryMediumPer AGENTS.md: first provide the file list + a commit message in Chinese and obtain the user’s consent; automatic commits are forbidden. See the list below
DRDS station nameLowread(/dev/fm) can read 688B blocks, but measurement shows The PS is is empty → no valid station name can be received in the current environment
EOther system-wide tinymix dependenciesLowAlready gracefully degraded; to truly fix it, a codec playback volume control is needed first (among card1’s 120 kcontrols, there is no playback volume control at all)

5.3 List of Files to Be Committed (commit only after the user’s consent)

Device-side repository /home/lvgl_demo/lvgl_demo (already tracked by git)

FileChange
lv_pages/radio_page.cThe page itself (this session: honest signal-strength area, removal of fake signal bars and rssi polling, bottom audio-output text, removal of the ANA button)
lv_pages/radio_page.hAdded
lv_pages/launcher_page.cThree radio entry points + correction of outdated comments
lv_status_bar/volume_control.cGraceful degradation when tinymix is missing (warning appears only once)
AI工作流/05_收音机/docs/FM收音_SEEK与场强_实测结论.mdAdded
AI工作流/05_收音机/docs/FM收音ioctl命令表_逆向还原.mdAdded §0.1 Important Corrections + script table supplements

Runtime artifacts outside the device-side repository (whether to commit them is to be decided)
/usr/local/bin/fm_user_daemon、/etc/local.d/zz_fm.start、/root/fm_watchdog.sh、
/root/log_rotate.sh、/etc/local.d/zz_crond.start、/etc/crontabs/root

Local engineering scripts ssh_tools/ (whether to commit them together with the repository is to be decided)
fm_user_daemon.c、radio_deploy.py、build_deploy.py、pull_file.py、log_rotate_install.py、
fm_seek_probe.c/fm_seek_probe2.c/fm_at_probe.c（含 _run.py）、fm_tune_probe.c（含 _run.py）、
fm_live_check.py、fm_rssi_sweep.py、fm_rssi_trace.py、fm_sigcmd_trace.py、fm_any.c、pcm_rec.c、dapm_graph2.py

VI. Quick Reference for Acceptance Commands

Windows-side tool scripts (ssh_tools/):

ScriptPurpose
radio_enter_test.py [键序列]Stop the watchdog → cleanly restart the app → screenshot → press keys → screenshot, and tail the app log
fm_live_check.pyDaemon command chain → radio page screenshot → return key → desktop screenshot
fm_rssi_sweep.pyMulti-frequency-point RSSI scan
fm_rssi_trace.pyCapture the complete FM driver log of a single tune+RSSI
fm_tune_probe.c / fm_tune_probe_run.pyDirectly dump the 32-byte structure written back by ioctl (to judge what the driver wrote)
fm_sigcmd_trace.pyTest signal-class commands under a clean dmesg and see whether there is SDIO traffic

VII. Next-Step Recommendations (Updated per This Round’s Results)

  1. Save the disk first ✅ Completed (129.9 MB → 65 KB, and hourly rotation installed).
  2. Change the signal area to honest text ✅ Completed.
  3. Add seek/scan/stopscan ❌ Disproved; will not be done: the SEEK parameters are truncated by the driver and SCAN is a hollow shell,
    so doing it would be “fake station search”. Do not turn unreliable capabilities into buttons.
  4. Making sound requires a user decision (the only real blocker): modify the kernel to add DAPM routes, request the new version of the Bluetooth protocol stack source code,
    or accept “demonstrable in UI/control only”.
  5. Committing the source code goes through approval (AGENTS.md: provide the list + a commit message in Chinese first; automatic commits are forbidden) —
    see §5.3 for the list.
  6. Optional minor optimization: make the threshold of /root/log_rotate.sh (currently 20 MB) and the list of logs to monitor configurable,
    to make it easy to add logs for new daemons in the future.

entry.title: FM收音機_進度快照_20260922
entry.content:
FM 收音機 —— 進度快照（2026-09-22）

範圍：展訊 SC9832A / Alpine Linux / armv7l / 720×1280 豎屏 / LVGL 9.6.0
本文只講具體實現到什麼程度：哪些能跑、哪些已驗收、哪些被實測否掉、還剩什麼。

一、一句話結論

FM 應用層已經做完並跑通：daemon + 收音機頁面 + 桌面入口 + 開機自啟，全鏈路可復現、可截圖驗收。
唯一無法在用戶態解決的是「出聲」 —— FM 音頻在硬件上只流向 FM 芯片自己的模擬輸出，
既不進整機 codec，也不進主機 capture，因此既不能外放、也不能數字化後餵給藍牙。

二、已完成並驗收（全部為設備實測）

2.1 FM daemon —— 完成度 100%（本機可用的命令）

設備端 /usr/local/bin/fm_user_daemon（19784 B），開機自啟，單實例，常駐。

能力實現方式實測結果
打開 FM 通道連 abstract unix socket @wcnd → 發 wcn FM-OPEN → 連接長期保持wcn FM-OPEN -> WCNBTWIFI-CMD OK
/dev/fm 句柄常開不關（close 會觸發 fm_release → 發 at+fm=12 阻塞 ~4 s）一直持有
通道自愈5 s 週期看門狗，通道掉了自動重開已實現
控制協議unix socket /tmp/fm_ctl.sock，文本單行命令見下表
命令超時保護SO_SNDTIMEO/SO_RCVTIMEO，回寫用 MSG_NOSIGNAL + SIGPIPE 忽略已修（見 §3.3）

協議與實測回執：

chipid=0x2341、rds=1 是由芯片真實讀回的值，證明整條 SDIO 通道是活的。

2.2 LVGL 收音機頁面 —— 完成度 100%（8 分區全部正確渲染）

設備端 lv_pages/radio_page.c（34287 B）。已用截圖逐區人工校對通過。

關鍵工程點（都踩過坑並已修）：

  1. UI 線程絕不做 socket I/O —— 獨立 IO 線程 rp_io_worker() 跑阻塞命令，
    LVGL 定時器 rp_poll_cb()（700 ms）只做加鎖 memcpy + 刷新控件。
    理由：rssi 單次要 4 s，直接在 UI 線程調用會卡死界面。
  2. 刻度尺寬度不能問 LVGL —— lv_obj_get_width() 在 onCreate 階段返回緩存 coords（= 0），
    被兜底成 10 後所有刻度擠在最左邊。改為自緩存寬度 rp_ruler_width() + 兜底值。
  3. 刻度指針不能掛在會被 clean 的父對象下 —— 原來掛在 marks 下，
    rebuild() 裡的 lv_obj_clean(marks) 會連指針一起刪掉。改掛 card。
  4. 刻度兩端內縮 —— 滿寬映射會把 108 標籤和 87.5 紅方塊擠出可視區。
  5. 生命週期：onPause 只停 UI 輪詢，絕不停 FM（回桌面要繼續放音）；
    onDestroy 只清自有句柄，不刪 root（由頁面管理器統一刪）。

2.3 頁面進入 / 返回 —— 本次已閉環驗收

截圖：shots/re_0.png（桌面，焦點框在收音機）、shots/re_1.png（收音機頁）、
shots/re_on.png（FM 上電後的收音機頁）、shots/re_after_back.png（返回後的桌面）。

⚠️ 之前”進不去頁面”是我自己的操作失誤，不是程序缺陷：
應用表裡 LAUNCHER_APP_RADIO 插在索引 8（設置/網絡/藍牙/收音機/圖庫），
而啟動時的初始焦點就是索引 8 = 收音機。我先前按 下→右→右→右→確認 反而把焦點移走了。
正確操作：桌面直接按「確認」即進收音機頁。

2.4 桌面入口 —— 完成度 100%

  • s_apps[] 新增 { LAUNCHER_APP_RADIO, "收音機", LV_SYMBOL_VOLUME_MAX, 0xe6614f }（第 2 行第 4 格，藍牙之後）。
  • 圖標用 LV_SYMBOL_VOLUME_MAX（喇叭）。
    實測本機 lv_font_cn_16 的 60 個 FontAwesome 圖標裡沒有任何”電臺/天線/電波”字形
    （F519/F2CE/F7C0/F8CE/F09E/F130 全渲染成 tofu 方框），故退用喇叭。
  • launcher_open_app() 增加 case LAUNCHER_APP_RADIO: → lv_start_activity(&g_radio_page, ...)。

2.5 開機自啟 —— 完成度 100%，已實測驗過

/etc/local.d/zz_fm.start（1172 B）：等 bt_user_daemon 最多 180 s（代表 WCN 鏈已就緒）→
殺舊實例 → 清 socket → setsid 啟動 → 6 s 後回報實例數/socket/日誌。
設備冷啟動後實測：fm_user_daemon 自動起來，chipid=0x2341 rds=1。

三、本次修正的舊結論（重要，別再按舊的做）

3.1 “音頻類 ioctl 可以配通音頻通路” → 全是空殼

OVER_BT_ENABLE 0x1D / ANA_SWITCH 0x1E / I2S_SETTING 0x21 / GET_I2S_INFO 0x29 / GET_AUDIO_INFO 0x30
在 marlin_fm.ko 裡只 printk 就返回，不產生任何 SDIO 流量。

判據（本機最硬的證據）：清空 dmesg 後調用它們，驅動只打印命令名，
完全不出現 fm_write_buf ... at+fm=xx 的 SDIO 收發；
而 POWER_UP / TUNE / GETRSSI 會打出 at+fm=1,9740 / at+fm=13 的完整收發對。

通用經驗：判斷一個 ioctl 是不是空殼，就看它有沒有產生真實的下層流量，而不是看 rc。

3.2 “按廠商 tiny_hw.xml 開 Speaker 就能出聲” → 內核裡不存在該路由

DAPM 圖（137 個 widget）實測拓撲不完整：

  • DACL Switch 的 out 只有 EAR Mixer；DACR Switch 無 out；
  • HPL/HPR/SPKL/SPKR Mixer 零輸入（完全孤立） → 走 speaker 物理上不可能；
  • 整機唯一可達的輸出終點是 EAR（聽筒）。

即便按真實路徑把 Earpiece Function 等 kcontrol 打開（實測 DAC→EAR 的 in 計數 0→2，鏈路是通的），
整機 codec 依然全 Off、bias_level=Off —— 通了，但沒上電。

3.3 “daemon 穩定” → 曾因 SIGPIPE 靜默退出，已修

客戶端（收音機頁）先斷開時，daemon 裡裸 write() 觸發 SIGPIPE，
默認動作是終止進程 → daemon 無聲無息死掉。已改為 MSG_NOSIGNAL + signal(SIGPIPE, SIG_IGN)。

3.4 “SEEK/SCAN 可用，能搜臺” → SEEK 參數被截斷、SCAN 是空殼（本輪新增）

  • SEEK (0x03) 真發 SDIO，但驅動把 u16 的起點頻率只取低字節拼進 AT 幀
    （974 → at+fm=4,0,206）→ 帶內頻點傳不進去；實測只有 92.5 / 103.1 兩個固定回值，
    且與當前頻點無關 → 不能做”下一個電臺”。
  • SCAN(0x08) / SCAN_NEW(0x3c)：返回 0 但零 SDIO 流量。
  • write(/dev/fm, "at+fm=...") 想繞開驅動 bug → 恆 **EINVAL(22)**，無 SDIO 流量。

詳細數據見 radio_docs/FM收音_SEEK與場強_實測結論.md。

3.5 “信號強度可以讀到” → 拿不到可信場強（本輪新增）

GETRSSI(0x07) 是唯一真發 SDIO 的信號類命令，但恆 ETIMEDOUT 耗時 4.2 s，
回值在 10 個頻點上幾乎不變（123~125）；其餘（SCAN_GETRSSI/CQI_GET/GETMONOSTERO/…）全是空殼；
TUNE 應答第 2 字段（164/139）也不是穩定指標且驅動不回寫給用戶態。
→ 收音機頁已移除假信號柱，改為「本機不提供場強查詢」。

四、阻塞項與不可行項（用戶態已無解）

4.1 FM 出聲 —— ❌ 用戶態無解（結論已定）

FM 音頻的三條可能出口全部被實測排除：

出口實測結果
① FM 芯片模擬輸出 → 整機 codec → 喇叭/耳機DAPM 路由表缺 HPL/SPKL，唯一可達終點 EAR；且整機 codec bias_level 恆 Off、Analog/Digital Power 全 Off
② OVER_BT_ENABLE / ANA_SWITCH / I2S_SETTING 切通路空殼 ioctl，無 SDIO 流量（§3.1）
③ 主機 capture 錄音 + 數字化後餵給藍牙 A2DP8 個 capture 設備全部 readi -5 EIO（card0 的 4 個連 set_params 都 -524 ENODEV）；read(/dev/fm) 只返回 688 B RDS 塊，沒有 PCM

根因：FM 音頻在硬件上只流向 FM 芯片自己的模擬輸出 → speaker/耳機，
沒有 FM 音頻通道進 AGDSP。因此既不能出聲、也不能數字化接管。

額外確認：FM 上電 + 打開 Dfm(hw:1,4) 後再錄 capture（最後一種組合）依然 EIO、DAPM 依然全 Off。

走到這一步需要（三選一，均超出用戶態）：

  • (a) 動內核：補 sprd-codec 的 DAPM route / 修 stream 觸發事件，讓整機 codec 上電；
  • (b) 拿到 BT 固件的「FM 直通」入口（HCI 廠商命令）；
  • (c) 索取新版 bt_user_daemon 源碼（當前設備上的版本不是本地 ref_src/ 裡那份舊版）。

4.2 信號強度表 —— ❌ 硬件不提供可用的查詢

本次掃了 10 個頻點 + 用探針 dump 了 ioctl 回寫結構體，結論：

  • GETRSSI (0x07)：唯一真的會去問芯片的信號類命令。芯片對 at+fm=13 回一個小整數（123~125），
    驅動把它寫進 arg 緩衝區的第 1 個字節；
    但 ioctl 每次都固定耗時 4.2 s 後返回 -1 / ETIMEDOUT(110)，
    且該值    在 10 個頻點上幾乎不變     → 不能當信號表用。
  • SCAN_GETRSSI 0x24、CQI_GET 0x27、GETMONOSTERO 0x0D、GETGOODBCNT 0x0F、
    GETBADBNT 0x10、GETBLERRATIO 0x11、IS_DESE_CHAN 0x2A：全部是空殼（只 printk，無 SDIO 流量）。
  • TUNE 的芯片應答 0,<X>,0,9740 裡第 2 字段看似與頻點相關（97.4→164、87.5→139），
    但同一頻點連調兩次得到 164 與 139 → 不是穩定的場強指標，且驅動不回寫該應答給用戶態。
  • RDS：數據通路是活的（能讀回 688 B 塊），但實測 blk2=blk4=180 恆定、The PS is（空）
    → 當前環境下收不到有效 RDS 臺名。

所以 UI 上那行「原始 N（查詢超時）」現在是如實反映硬件狀態，
但作為”信號表”是無意義的。已在 §5 完成改造（改為固定文案 + 移除輪詢）。

4.3 搜臺（SEEK）—— ❌ 參數被驅動截斷，不能做”下一個電臺”

SEEK (0x03) 確實真發 SDIO（at+fm=4,<p2>,<p3>，每次約 1.43 s，能拿到
fm seek event have come freq=...），但參數是壞的：

我們傳的起點 freq驅動實際發出芯片回幀驅動回寫的”找到頻點”
974 (97.4MHz)at+fm=4,0,2063,139,0,9250925 = 92.5MHz
875 / 1080 / 900 / 1000,0,107 / ,0,56 / ,0,132 / ,0,2323,139,0,9250925
0at+fm=4,0,03,139,0,103101031 = 103.1MHz
  • 驅動把 u16 的 freq 只取低字節拼進 AT 幀 → 帶內頻點（875~1080）永遠傳不進去；
  • AT 幀第 2 個參數恆為 0（把 zero/band/one/pad 改成 1/2 都不變）；
  • 結果與當前頻點無關：先 TUNE 到 87.5 / 97.4 / 100.0 / 103.1，再 SEEK(0)，四次都回 103.1。

→ SEEK 退化成”92.5 或 103.1 二選一”，不是搜臺。UI 不應提供”搜臺”按鈕。

補充排除的兩條路：

  • SCAN(0x08) / SCAN_NEW(0x3c)：返回 0 但零 SDIO 流量（空殼）；STOP_SCAN(0x09) 恆 EINVAL(22)。
  • write(/dev/fm, "at+fm=4,0,9740") 想直接寫 AT 文本繞開驅動 bug → 恆定 **-1 / EINVAL(22)**，
    dmesg 無任何 fm_write_buf → 驅動不接收用戶態 AT 文本，此路不通。

取證腳本：ssh_tools/fm_seek_probe.c / fm_seek_probe2.c / fm_at_probe.c（含 _run.py）。
完整數據見 AI工作流/05_收音機/docs/FM收音_SEEK與場強_實測結論.md。

五、未完成 / 待辦（★ 2026-09-22 深夜續做後的最新狀態）

5.1 本輪已完成 ✅

#事項結果
5/tmp/btud_dbg.log 加輪轉✅ 129.9 MB → 65 KB，根分區 77% → 75%；裝了 busybox crond（整點跑 /root/log_rotate.sh）+ 開機自啟 /etc/local.d/zz_crond.start；實測日誌繼續正常增長、非稀疏文件
1UI 場強區改誠實文案✅ 刪除 5 根假信號柱，改為「場強　本機不提供場強查詢」；截圖 shots/dep_1E.png 已驗收
2去掉 rssi 無謂輪詢✅ 移除 want_rssi 邏輯（原來每次調臺後白等 4.2 s）；rssi 命令在 daemon 側保留供實驗
—底部”音頻通路”文案✅ 改為「音頻輸出: 本機暫不可用（無可用通路）」，並移除了無效果的「切換音頻通路」按鈕（ANA_SWITCH 是空殼，留著只誤導）
4整機音量控制✅ 優雅降級：首次探測 tinymix 不存在即置”不可用”，告警只出現一次（原來是每次拖滑塊 fork 一個必然返回 127 的 shell）；實測日誌 grep -c 'Volume System' = 1
7launcher_page.c 過期註釋✅ 已改正（下標 8 現在是收音機，不是任務管理；保持行為不變）
8radio_docs/ 文檔✅ 新增 FM收音_SEEK與場強_實測結論.md；在 FM收音ioctl命令表_逆向還原.md 頂部加了 §0.1 重要更正（推翻”SCAN/SCAN_GETRSSI 可畫頻譜””SEEK 可搜臺””可寫 AT 文本”三條舊結論）

本輪驗收截圖

截圖內容
shots/fin_0.png桌面：12 個應用圖標齊全，「收音機」喇叭圖標正常，焦點框（粉色描邊）就落在「收音機」上 → 直觀印證 s_apps[] 下標 8 = 收音機
shots/dep_1E.png / shots/fin_1.png收音機頁 8 分區全部正確；「場強 本機不提供場強查詢」「音頻輸出: 本機暫不可用（無可用通路）」，無假信號柱、無 ANA 按鈕

進程終態（設備實測）
lvgl_demo 15468 + lvgl_watchdog 15681；fm_user_daemon 2491 + fm_watchdog 20199；
bt_user_daemon 1222、wcnd 1155、crond 20905（整點輪轉）

5.2 仍未完成 / 待用戶決定 ⏳

#事項優先級說明
AFM 出聲阻塞（需拍板）用戶態已無解，三條路任選：(a) 動內核補 sprd-codec 的 DAPM route / 修 stream 觸發；(b) 拿 BT 固件的「FM 直通」入口（HCI 廠商命令）；(c) 接受”FM 僅 UI/控制可演示，無聲音”
B索取新版 bt_user_daemon 源碼中若走 (b) 需要它
C源碼入庫中按 AGENTS.md：先給文件清單 + 中文提交說明並獲用戶同意，禁止自動提交。清單見下
DRDS 臺名低read(/dev/fm) 能讀 688B 塊，但實測 The PS is 為空 → 當前環境收不到有效臺名
E整機其它 tinymix 依賴低已優雅降級；真要修需先有 codec 播放音量控件（card1 的 120 個 kcontrol 裡沒有任何播放音量控件）

5.3 待入庫文件清單（等用戶同意後再 commit）

設備端倉庫 /home/lvgl_demo/lvgl_demo（git 已跟蹤）

文件改動
lv_pages/radio_page.c頁面本體（本會話：場強區誠實化、去掉假信號柱與 rssi 輪詢、底部音頻輸出文案、移除 ANA 按鈕）
lv_pages/radio_page.h新增
lv_pages/launcher_page.c收音機入口三處 + 過期註釋改正
lv_status_bar/volume_control.ctinymix 缺失時優雅降級（告警只出一次）
AI工作流/05_收音機/docs/FM收音_SEEK與場強_實測結論.md新增
AI工作流/05_收音機/docs/FM收音ioctl命令表_逆向還原.md加 §0.1 重要更正 + 腳本表補充

設備端倉庫外的運行期產物（是否入庫請定）
/usr/local/bin/fm_user_daemon、/etc/local.d/zz_fm.start、/root/fm_watchdog.sh、
/root/log_rotate.sh、/etc/local.d/zz_crond.start、/etc/crontabs/root

本地工程腳本 ssh_tools/（是否隨倉庫一起提交請定）
fm_user_daemon.c、radio_deploy.py、build_deploy.py、pull_file.py、log_rotate_install.py、
fm_seek_probe.c/fm_seek_probe2.c/fm_at_probe.c（含 _run.py）、fm_tune_probe.c（含 _run.py）、
fm_live_check.py、fm_rssi_sweep.py、fm_rssi_trace.py、fm_sigcmd_trace.py、fm_any.c、pcm_rec.c、dapm_graph2.py

六、驗收命令速查

Windows 側工具腳本（ssh_tools/）：

腳本用途
radio_enter_test.py [鍵序列]停 watchdog → 乾淨重啟應用 → 截圖 → 按鍵 → 截圖，並把應用日誌 tail 出來
fm_live_check.pydaemon 命令鏈 → 收音機頁截圖 → 返回鍵 → 桌面截圖
fm_rssi_sweep.py多頻點 RSSI 掃描
fm_rssi_trace.py抓單次 tune+RSSI 的完整 FM 驅動日誌
fm_tune_probe.c / fm_tune_probe_run.py直接 dump ioctl 回寫的 32 字節結構體（判斷驅動寫了什麼）
fm_sigcmd_trace.py乾淨 dmesg 下測試信號類命令，看是否有 SDIO 流量

七、下一步建議（已按本輪結果更新）

  1. 先把磁盤救回來 ✅ 已完成（129.9 MB → 65 KB，並裝了整點輪轉）。
  2. 信號區改成誠實文案 ✅ 已完成。
  3. 補 seek/scan/stopscan ❌ 已證偽，不做：SEEK 參數被驅動截斷、SCAN 是空殼，
    做了就是”假搜臺”。不要把不可靠的能力做成按鈕。
  4. 出聲需要用戶拍板（唯一真阻塞）：動內核補 DAPM 路由、去要新版藍牙協議棧源碼、
    還是接受”僅 UI/控制可演示”。
  5. 源碼入庫走審批（AGENTS.md：先給清單 + 中文提交說明，禁止自動提交）——
    清單見 §5.3。
  6. 可選小優化：把 /root/log_rotate.sh 的閾值（現 20 MB）與要監控的日誌列表做成可配，
    方便以後加新 daemon 的日誌。

版權聲明：本文為 whiteleibniz 原創文章（AI 協作整理），版權歸 whiteleibniz 所有，轉載請註明出處與原文鏈接：https://whiteleibniz.github.io

entry.title: AI 工作流归档规范
entry.content:
AI 工作流归档

本目录归档 AI 协作过程中每次任务的最终可交付产物，按业务目标拆分子目录。
规则：只收”能直接部署运行、达到结果”的最终产物（交付文档 / 最终服务源码 / 设备实际运行的部署脚本）；
过程用的临时脚本（部署调试、测试、诊断、探索类）一律不归档。

隐私红线（强制）

  • 项目公开：文档、git 备注、归档文件中禁止出现真实 SSH 密码、账号、真实 IP。
  • 一律使用占位符：<设备IP> / <WiFi-IP> / <密码>；真实凭据只在运行参数或环境变量中提供。

目录规范

子目录内容
01_WiFi打通/docs: 操作手册/流程对比/工作总结/AI指导手册/故障排查手册/部署交付文档；deploy: wifi.start（开机部署脚本）
02_蓝牙打通/docs: 6份文档（含故障排查手册）；src: bt_user_daemon.c(最终服务源码)+bluetooth_page.c/h(LVGL界面源码)；deploy: bt_bringup.start/bt_daemon/bt_wake.sh(设备实际运行部署)
03_HT0可复用资产/ht0-wcn-radio Skill 快照（SKILL.md + references + 可直接运行的运维脚本）
04_桌面应用框架/docs: LVGL 桌面应用架构与第三方接入规范
05_收音机/docs: FM 收音机规划与逆向文档（LVGL界面设计规格 / AI指导手册 / 操作手册 / 故障排查手册 / 原理与移植Wiki / 启动流程对比 / 部署交付文档 / 工作过程总结 / ioctl命令表逆向还原）；src: fmprobe.c（ioctl 实测探针，已验证 45/47）；fm_user_daemon.c（待实装）
bugfix/每次 bug 修复的说明文档（现象/根因/定位/解决/验证），索引见 bugfix/README.md

新增业务目标时按 NN_业务名/ 递增编号，docs / src / deploy 视需要拆分。

文档同步协议（版本化，打 tag 时同步）

文档不随每次迭代提交更新，按版本定版（打 tag）统一同步：

  1. 日常迭代：只提交代码 / 脚本 / 配置改动，备注写清改动内容；不动文档。
  2. 打 tag 定版（用户确认功能完善 / 稳定）时，一次性同步：
    • 对应任务 docs/ 文档族（操作手册 / 故障排查手册 / AI指导手册 / 部署交付文档 / 流程对比 / 工作总结）+ Skill 资产（SKILL.md、references/、scripts/）
    • 文件增删改名时更新本 README 目录规范
    • 校验：文档中命令 / 路径 / 产物与设备实际运行状态一致（改过的层须实测过）
    • 打 tag：git tag <vX.Y.Z>，备注中文，写明「定版范围 + 同步更新的文档清单」
  3. tag 提交包含或紧随文档更新，保证「一个 tag = 一份完整文档快照」可回溯。

entry.title: AI Workflow Archiving Standards
entry.content:
AI 工作流归档 (AI Workflow Archiving)

This directory archives the final deliverables of each task in AI collaboration, split into subdirectories by business objective.
Rule: only final deliverables that “can be deployed and run directly and achieve the result” are collected (delivery documents / final service source code / deployment scripts actually running on the device);
temporary scripts used in the process (deployment debugging, testing, diagnostics, exploration) are never archived.

Privacy Red Lines (mandatory)

  • Public projects: real SSH passwords, accounts, and real IP addresses are forbidden in documents, git commit messages, and archived files.
  • Always use placeholders: <设备IP> / <WiFi-IP> / <密码>; real credentials are provided only through runtime parameters or environment variables.

Directory Specifications

SubdirectoryContents
01_WiFi打通/docs: operation manual / process comparison / work summary / AI guidance manual / troubleshooting manual / deployment delivery document; deploy: wifi.start (boot deployment script)
02_蓝牙打通/docs: 6 documents (including the troubleshooting manual); src: bt_user_daemon.c (final service source code) + bluetooth_page.c/h (LVGL UI source code); deploy: bt_bringup.start/bt_daemon/bt_wake.sh (deployment actually running on the device)
03_HT0可复用资产/ht0-wcn-radio Skill snapshot (SKILL.md + references + directly runnable ops scripts)
04_桌面应用框架/docs: LVGL desktop application architecture and third-party integration specifications
05_收音机/docs: FM radio planning and reverse-engineering documents (LVGL UI design specification / AI guidance manual / operation manual / troubleshooting manual / principles and porting Wiki / boot process comparison / deployment delivery document / work process summary / ioctl command table reverse-engineered reconstruction); src: fmprobe.c (ioctl live probe, 45/47 verified); fm_user_daemon.c (to be implemented)
bugfix/explanation document for each bug fix (symptom/root cause/localization/solution/verification); see bugfix/README.md for the index

When adding a new business objective, number it incrementally as NN_业务名/, and split docs / src / deploy as needed.

Document Synchronization Protocol (versioned, synced when tagging)

Documents are not updated with every iteration commit; they are synced uniformly at version freeze (tag):

  1. Daily iteration: commit only code / script / configuration changes, with commit messages describing the changes; do not touch documents.
  2. At version freeze (when the user confirms the feature is complete / stable), sync all at once:
    • the corresponding task’s docs/ document family (operation manual / troubleshooting manual / AI guidance manual / deployment delivery document / process comparison / work summary) + Skill assets (SKILL.md, references/, scripts/)
    • when files are added, deleted, or renamed, update this README’s directory specifications
    • Verification: commands / paths / artifacts in the documents match the device’s actual running state (changed layers must have been tested live)
    • Tag: git tag <vX.Y.Z>, with the commit note in Chinese, stating “freeze scope + list of synced documents”
  3. The tag commit includes or immediately follows the document updates, ensuring that “one tag = one complete document snapshot” is traceable.

Copyright: This article is an original work by whiteleibniz (organized with AI assistance). All rights reserved. Please credit the source and keep the original link: https://whiteleibniz.github.io

entry.title: AI 工作流歸檔規範
entry.content:
AI 工作流歸檔

本目錄歸檔 AI 協作過程中每次任務的最終可交付產物，按業務目標拆分子目錄。
規則：只收”能直接部署運行、達到結果”的最終產物（交付文檔 / 最終服務源碼 / 設備實際運行的部署腳本）；
過程用的臨時腳本（部署調試、測試、診斷、探索類）一律不歸檔。

隱私紅線（強制）

  • 項目公開：文檔、git 備註、歸檔文件中禁止出現真實 SSH 密碼、賬號、真實 IP。
  • 一律使用佔位符：<設備IP> / <WiFi-IP> / <密碼>；真實憑據只在運行參數或環境變量中提供。

目錄規範

子目錄內容
01_WiFi打通/docs: 操作手冊/流程對比/工作總結/AI指導手冊/故障排查手冊/部署交付文檔；deploy: wifi.start（開機部署腳本）
02_藍牙打通/docs: 6份文檔（含故障排查手冊）；src: bt_user_daemon.c(最終服務源碼)+bluetooth_page.c/h(LVGL界面源碼)；deploy: bt_bringup.start/bt_daemon/bt_wake.sh(設備實際運行部署)
03_HT0可複用資產/ht0-wcn-radio Skill 快照（SKILL.md + references + 可直接運行的運維腳本）
04_桌面應用框架/docs: LVGL 桌面應用架構與第三方接入規範
05_收音機/docs: FM 收音機規劃與逆向文檔（LVGL界面設計規格 / AI指導手冊 / 操作手冊 / 故障排查手冊 / 原理與移植Wiki / 啟動流程對比 / 部署交付文檔 / 工作過程總結 / ioctl命令表逆向還原）；src: fmprobe.c（ioctl 實測探針，已驗證 45/47）；fm_user_daemon.c（待實裝）
bugfix/每次 bug 修復的說明文檔（現象/根因/定位/解決/驗證），索引見 bugfix/README.md

新增業務目標時按 NN_業務名/ 遞增編號，docs / src / deploy 視需要拆分。

文檔同步協議（版本化，打 tag 時同步）

文檔不隨每次迭代提交更新，按版本定版（打 tag）統一同步：

  1. 日常迭代：只提交代碼 / 腳本 / 配置改動，備註寫清改動內容；不動文檔。
  2. 打 tag 定版（用戶確認功能完善 / 穩定）時，一次性同步：
    • 對應任務 docs/ 文檔族（操作手冊 / 故障排查手冊 / AI指導手冊 / 部署交付文檔 / 流程對比 / 工作總結）+ Skill 資產（SKILL.md、references/、scripts/）
    • 文件增刪改名時更新本 README 目錄規範
    • 校驗：文檔中命令 / 路徑 / 產物與設備實際運行狀態一致（改過的層須實測過）
    • 打 tag：git tag <vX.Y.Z>，備註中文，寫明「定版範圍 + 同步更新的文檔清單」
  3. tag 提交包含或緊隨文檔更新，保證「一個 tag = 一份完整文檔快照」可回溯。

entry.title: 收音机刻度尺全挤在左侧
entry.content:
bugfix_20260922_02 — 收音机页刻度尺所有刻度挤在左侧

关联提交：221fa7d

现象

新增的「FM 收音机」页面（lv_pages/radio_page.c）中，D 区频率刻度尺（覆盖 88~108 MHz，
应横向铺满卡片）所有刻度线、数字标签、收藏方块全部挤在卡片最左侧约 10px 内，
肉眼看起来就是一小坨竖着堆叠的重影；右侧整片空白。

影响范围

  • 只影响 radio_page.c 的刻度尺（rp_ruler_rebuild() / rp_ruler_pointer_update()）。
  • 同页面其它分区（标题栏、当前频点、信号柱、控制按钮、收藏列表、音量条）不受影响 ——
    它们的坐标是写死的常量，不依赖运行时取宽。
  • 不影响任何其它页面。

根因

LVGL 9 的 lv_obj_get_width() 返回的是缓存坐标区 obj->coords，而不是刚 lv_obj_set_size() 设进去的值。

证据（设备端源码）：

coords 只在布局周期（lv_obj_update_layout / 刷新）里才被刷新。而
rp_ruler_rebuild() 是在 onCreate() 里紧跟着 lv_obj_set_size(marks, w, 78) 调用的，
此刻布局还没跑过，coords 仍是全 0 → lv_obj_get_width() 返回 0。

代码里还有一句”兜底”把问题藏得更深：

于是 21 个刻度 + 6 个标签 + 5 个收藏方块全部落在 x=0~9，视觉上就是左侧一坨。

定位过程

  1. 先看整页截图：其它分区都对，只有刻度尺塌了 → 先怀疑是容器布局（flex）接管了子对象坐标。
  2. 在 rp_ruler_rebuild() 里加临时探针，直接打印运行时几何：实测输出：→ get_width=10 而不是应有的 652（=720-24-44）。坐标本身没问题，就是宽度取值错了。
  3. grep lv_obj_get_width 到源码，确认它读 coords，锁定根因。
  4. 排除过的错误方向：
    • 曾怀疑 lv_obj_set_layout(marks, LV_LAYOUT_NONE) 没生效被 flex 接管 → 不是，set_pos 本身生效了；
    • 曾怀疑是”标签 x-12 越界” → 那是另一个真实但次要的问题（见下”注”）。

解决办法

把创建时显式设过的宽度缓存下来，不再依赖运行时取宽（remote_src/radio_page.c）：

三处用宽度的代码（刻度 x、收藏方块 x、指针 x）统一改走 rp_ruler_width()。

同时修掉同一函数里的第二个 bug：指针原本是 marks 的子对象，而
rp_ruler_rebuild() 第一件事就是 lv_obj_clean(marks) —— 会把指针一起删掉，
s_rp.ruler_pointer 变成悬垂指针。现改为在 clean 之后重新创建指针并立即
rp_ruler_pointer_update()。

注（顺带修的第三个问题）：刻度 x 原本按 [0, w] 满宽映射，标签以中心对齐，
导致最右的 “108” 被卡片边缘裁掉（实测截图只显示 “10”）。加左右内缩
RP_RULER_PAD 14 后两端标签都能完整显示。

验证

  1. 重新编译部署：ssh_tools/radio_dev.py remote_src/radio_page.c:lv_pages/radio_page.c
  2. 用标准键码注入导航进收音机页（见 bugfix_03 的键码说明），或直接 ssh_tools/radio_page_snap.py
  3. 人眼看物理屏（截图仅作留档）：刻度尺横向铺满，88/92/96/100/104/108 六个标签
    全部完整可见，偶数 MHz 长刻度 / 奇数 MHz 短刻度交替，5 个收藏红方块与当前频点指针
    落在正确比例位置（87.5 在最左、106.1 在偏右）。
  4. 局部放大复核：python ssh_tools/zoom_crop.py shots/_fb_tmp.raw shots/zoom_ruler2.png 0 262 720 108 2
    → 结果确认修好。

经验教训

  1. LVGL 9 里 lv_obj_get_*() 系列（width/height/x/y）读的都是缓存 coords，不是”刚设进去的值”。
    凡是”创建对象 → 立刻按它的尺寸算子对象坐标”的场景，都必须自己缓存那个尺寸，
    或者先显式 lv_obj_update_layout(obj)。这是一个会静默出错（返回 0）的坑。
  2. **”兜底” if 会把 bug 从”崩溃/明显异常”变成”看起来能跑的错值”**：
    if (w < 10) w = 10; 让 0 变成了 10，症状从”什么都没有”变成”全挤在左边”，
    多花了一轮才定位。兜底值要么等于正常量级，要么就该直接报错。
  3. lv_obj_clean(parent) 会删掉 parent 的所有子对象。常驻句柄不能挂在会被
    clean 的容器下；否则必须显式地在 clean 之后重建。
  4. 给容器子对象设坐标前，先确认容器的 layout 是 NONE（本页其它卡片恰好没被 flex 接管）。
  5. 调试界面几何问题的性价比最高手段：在函数里打一行 fprintf 把运行时数字打出来，
    比对着截图猜快一个数量级。

entry.title: mplayer视频红蓝通道错乱
entry.content:
bugfix_20260922_01 mplayer 播放视频红蓝通道错乱

现象：桌面图标与 FC 游戏颜色已修正后，用「视频」页播放 mp4 时颜色仍然不对（红蓝互换）。
根因层：framebuffer 色彩元数据 × 外部播放器（mplayer -vo fbdev）。
修复工作量：2 个源文件 +54/-2 与 +50/-2，外加 miniretro 重编。
文件名：bugfix_20260922_01_mplayer视频红蓝通道错乱.md
关联提交：5113a12
日期：2026-09-22

1. 现象

同一块屏幕上，不同功能的颜色表现不一致：

功能颜色表现
桌面图标、文字、背景正常（此前已修正）
FC 游戏（miniretro）正常
「视频」页播放 mp4红蓝互换（红色物体显示成蓝色）

关键点：只有视频播放器不对。这本身就说明问题不在”整个屏幕的色彩方案”，
而在”视频播放器这条独立路径”。

2. 影响范围

  • 受影响：lv_pages/video_player_page.c 走的外部 mplayer 进程播放的所有视频。
  • 不受影响：LVGL 自绘部分（桌面/各页面）、miniretro（FC 游戏）——
    它们各自有独立的写 fb 路径与本地的 R/B 交换，无需改动。

3. 根因

3.1 前提：本机屏幕真实字节序与驱动报告相反

FBIOGET_VSCREENINFO 报告 r16:8 g8:8 b0:8（语义 [B,G,R,X]），
但用纯色写 fb + 人眼确认，**真实字节序是 [R,G,B,X]**：

写入 fb 的内存字节屏幕实际显示
[00,00,FF,FF]蓝
[FF,00,00,FF]红

→ offset0 = 红、offset2 = 蓝，与驱动报告恰好相反。

3.2 核心机制：外部播放器会读取这份元数据并据此写像素

libs/mplayer/mplayer（MPlayer 1.4-13）的 fbdev 输出驱动在初始化时读
FBIOGET_VSCREENINFO，按读到的 offset 决定自己把颜色写到哪个字节，
并在日志里打印它选定的布局：

  • BGRA = 蓝在字节 0 → 但本面板要红在字节 0 → 屏幕上红蓝互换 ✗
  • RGBA = 红在字节 0 → 与面板一致 ✓

所以 mplayer 的代码没错，它只是老实照驱动谎报的参数办事。

3.3 为什么这里不能靠改代码解决

消费者取色方式可否改代码
LVGL（main.c fb_flush_cb）自己打包像素、直接写内存✅ 已改（交换 R/B）
miniretro（scale_rotate90）自己打包像素、直接写内存✅ 已改（交换 R/B）
mplayer（-vo fbdev）读 fb 元数据，据此写❌ 第三方预编译二进制，无源码

mplayer 是 13.7 MB 的预编译 ELF（libs/mplayer/mplayer），设备上没有源码，
所以改不了它的代码 —— 只能改它读到的参数。

4. 定位过程

4.1 走过的弯路（记录下来避免重走）

错误方向为什么错
在系统路径找 mplayer（/usr/bin、/usr/local/bin）全部不存在 → 一度误判”设备上没有播放器”。实际在 libs/mplayer/mplayer，由 video_find_mplayer() 的相对路径候选命中
试 -vf format=bgr32 / format=rgb32 / format=bgra全部无效。fbdev vo 会覆盖 format 滤镜的选择，四组输出字节完全相同
试 -vo fbdev2与 fbdev 行为相同，仍是 BGRA
想改自定义 lvfb 驱动该 mplayer 里确有 lvfb（”LVGL-style framebuffer output”）驱动，但它拒绝本机格式：[lvfb] unsupported framebuffer format: 720x1280 32bpp r16:8 g8:8 b0:8（校正成 r0:8 b16:8 后依然拒绝）。设备上没有 lvfb 源码，无法修改
用 ffmpeg -f lavfi 造纯色测试视频设备没有 ffmpeg，此路不通。改用现有 mp4 直接比对

4.2 决定性实验：只改 fb var，看输出字节是否变化

控制变量：同一条命令、同一个 mp4，唯一变化是 fb var。

结果（屏中央采样）：

情形VO: 日志行屏中央字节
A 出厂 varVO: [fbdev] ... BGRA[e5 d7 cc ff]
B 校正 varVO: [fbdev] ... RGBA[cc d7 e5 ff]

只有 R/B 两个字节互换，其余完全一致 —— 干净地指向 fb var 这一个变量。

4.3 关键排除实验：改 var 会不会影响控制器实际取色？

这是决定”叠加修正”还是”替换修正”的分水岭。

做法：把 var 校正为 r0:8 b16:8 后，往 fb 写同样的 [FF 00 00 FF]，
让用户目视报告颜色。

结果：用户答「红色」——与改 var 之前看到的颜色完全相同。

结论：red/green/blue.offset 只是给软件读取的元数据，控制器不理会它。
改 var 不影响硬件扫描取色，只影响”读这份元数据的软件”（即 mplayer）。

→ 因此修正是叠加式：必须校正 var（修 mplayer），
而 LVGL/miniretro 自己的 R/B 交换必须保留（删了就双重交换，反而变回错的）。

5. 解决办法

5.1 新增一个幂等的 var 校正函数

在 fb_init() 里（打开 fb 之后立刻）调用一次，把 var 校正为 r0:8 g8:8 b16:8：

5.2 在两处 fb_init() 中调用

文件位置作用
main.cfb_init() 打开 g_fb_fd 后mplayer 是 lvgl_demo 的子进程，自然继承正确状态
extern/miniretro/miniretro.cfb_init() 打开 fb_fd 后脱离主程序单独跑游戏时，fb 状态也正确

5.3 保持不变的部分（重要）

  • main.c 的 fb_flush_cb：保留 R/B 交换
  • extern/miniretro/miniretro.c 的 scale_rotate90：保留 R/B 交换

这两者直接写内存、不读元数据，删掉交换就会双重交换变回错的。

6. 验证

6.1 自动化验证（var 是否自愈 + mplayer 布局是否改变）

实测结果：var 自动由 r16:8 g8:8 b0:8 变为 r0:8 g8:8 b16:8，
日志输出 [fb] color spec -> r0:8 g8:8 b16:8，mplayer 布局由 BGRA 变 RGBA。✓

6.2 人眼验证（必需）

用户在设备上打开「视频」→ 播放 mp4 → 目视确认画面颜色。

用户确认结果：「颜色正确了」。✓

6.3 回归验证（确认没把修好的弄坏）

  • 桌面 16 个图标颜色逐一与 s_apps[] 色表核对 → 全部吻合
    （蓝牙 #1e88e5、网络 #56ccf2、关机 #e74c3c、音乐 #eb5757、LED灯控 #ffb300 …）
  • FC 游戏颜色 → 正常
  • 部署校验：md5sum /usr/local/bin/lvgl_demo build/lvgl_demo 两者一致 ✓

7. 经验教训

  1. “同一个屏幕上，不同进程的修法不同” —— 这是本次最大的认知跃迁。
    写 fb 的消费者分三类：

    • 自绘程序（LVGL、miniretro）→ 改代码，在自己写入点交换
    • 读元数据的外部程序（mplayer -vo fbdev）→ 改参数（校正 fb var）
    • 内核/控制器 → 通常不可改，且实测忽略 var

    只修一类就会留下”某个功能颜色还是错的”。排查颜色问题第一步应先枚举所有写 fb 的进程。

  2. 先看外部程序自己打印的选择。mplayer 的 VO: [fbdev] ... BGRA 一行
    直接说明了它的判断依据，比任何推理都快。有日志就别猜。

  3. **控制变量的 A/B 实验优于”改一堆再试”**。同命令 + 同素材 + 只改一个变量
    （fb var），得到”只有 R/B 两字节互换”的干净结论，直接锁定因果。

  4. 区分”元数据”与”硬件行为”。改 var.red.offset 前先问：
    “它是被硬件用的，还是只被软件读的？” —— 用”改前后写同样字节看屏幕是否变化”
    就能回答。这个判断决定了修正是叠加还是替换，    判错就会双重交换    。

  5. 命令行选项要先验证再放弃。-vf format=...、-vo fbdev2 看起来合理，
    实测全部无效。花几分钟证伪，胜过凭直觉重编播放器。

  6. 不要用 pkill -f <pattern> 杀守护进程。pkill -9 -f lvgl_watchdog 会匹配到
    承载该命令的 shell 自身（其命令行含该字符串）→ 杀掉自己的 SSH 会话，
    表现为 RC: -1 且输出被截断，看起来像”命令根本没执行”。按 PID 杀：

  7. 给远端打补丁后，用 git diff --ignore-cr-at-eol 复核。
    git diff 曾把 54 行的真实改动显示成 1618 行”整文件重写”——
    那只是 CRLF/LF 触发 git 行尾启发式，不是改坏了。

附：涉及文件

文件改动备份
main.c+54 / -2（新增 fb_fix_color_spec() + 调用）main.c.bak_20260922_181354
extern/miniretro/miniretro.c+50 / -2（同上）extern/miniretro/miniretro.c.bak_20260922_181354
extern/miniretro/miniretro二进制重编（25620 → 25648 字节）—
libs/mplayer/mplayer未改动（只改了 fb 参数，播放器本体不动）—

entry.title: FM_daemon因SIGPIPE静默退出
entry.content:
bugfix_20260922_03 — FM daemon 无故消失，收音机页永远显示”芯片 0000”

关联提交：221fa7d

现象

fm_user_daemon 运行一段时间后无声无息地消失（ps 里找不到，socket 文件
/tmp/fm_ctl.sock 还在但 connect() 返回 Connection refused）。
收音机页因此永远显示 芯片 0000、RDS 不可用、已关闭，所有按钮点了没反应。
日志的最后几行只有正常的 cmd='state' / cmd='rssi'，完全没有崩溃信息。

影响范围

  • 只影响 FM 收音机功能（页面 ↔ daemon 链路全断）。
  • 不影响 lvgl_demo 主体：lvgl_demo 有自己的 /root/lvgl_watchdog.sh 保活，一直正常。
  • 影响所有依赖 /dev/fm 常开 fd 的功能：daemon 一死，/dev/fm 被 close 触发
    fm_release（发 at+fm=12 并阻塞约 4s），FM 状态丢失。

根因

对端已关闭的 socket 上做普通 write() 会触发 SIGPIPE，其默认动作是终止进程。

daemon 的回写函数原本是：

且 main() 里没有 signal(SIGPIPE, SIG_IGN)。

而客户端（lvgl_demo 收音机页）在”回复写出之前”断开是常态：

  • 页面 onDestroy/应用被 killall 时连接被关；
  • 页面的 IO 工作线程对 rssi 命令设 6s 超时，但内核 GETRSSI 要 ~4s；
    页面还会在超时后重连 → 旧连接被丢弃。

一旦发生，daemon 被 SIGPIPE 打死，没有任何日志（信号默认动作，不产生用户态输出）。

定位过程

  1. 先确认进程真的没了、socket 是陈旧的（pidof 空、Connection refused）。
  2. 看 daemon 源码的退出路径：main() 里 setup 之后的 for(;;) accept(...) 是死循环，
    **没有任何主动 exit()**；各命令分支也没有。→ 排除”逻辑自己退出”。
  3. 于是只剩”被信号杀死 / 段错误”。grep 信号与写操作：
  4. 时间线吻合：每次”daemon 消失”都发生在我重启 lvgl_demo 应用之后。
  5. 做对照实验证明机制（ssh_tools/sigpipe_ctrl.c）：fork 两个子进程，各自
    socketpair() 后关掉对端，A 组用裸 write()、B 组用 send(..., MSG_NOSIGNAL)：A 组完全没有输出 → 确实被 SIGPIPE 终止。 机制在本机得到证实。

解决办法

两处修改（ssh_tools/fm_user_daemon.c）：

  1. 统一 socket 写函数，永不产生 SIGPIPE：
    • reply() 改用它；
    • wcnd_fm_open() 里向 @wcnd 写 "wcn FM-OPEN" 也改用它（同样是对端可能已断的 socket）。
  2. main() 开头加兜底：

另加保活看门狗 /root/fm_watchdog.sh（每 5 秒 pidof fm_user_daemon，不在就拉起，
模式与既有 /root/lvgl_watchdog.sh 一致），防御 OOM/SIGKILL 等其它死法。

验证

  • 回归测试（设备端 python3 /root/fm_sigpipe_test.py）：6 轮”连上 → 发 rssi
    （内核要 ~4s 才回）→ 0.15s 后立刻 close()“，正是原本必死的最坏时序。
    结果：6 轮全部存活，daemon pid 始终 6408 不变 → PASSED。
  • 对照实验（上节 sigpipe_ctrl）：A 组静默死亡 / B 组存活 → 反证修复必要且有效。
  • 重启应用后重进收音机页，页面恢复显示 RDS 可用 · 芯片 2341 · 收听中。
  • 设备自行重启后，/etc/local.d/zz_fm.start 自动把 daemon 拉起（日志
    [fm] wcn FM-OPEN -> WCNBTWIFI-CMD OK、chipid=0x2341 rds=1、就绪，监听 /tmp/fm_ctl.sock）。

经验教训

  1. 写 socket 一律用 send(..., MSG_NOSIGNAL)，并在长驻进程开头 signal(SIGPIPE, SIG_IGN)。
    SIGPIPE 是”静默杀手”：不产生任何日志，现象是”进程莫名消失”，
    极易被误判为 OOM 或”自己退出了”。
  2. “没有 exit() 但进程没了” → 优先怀疑信号。 排查顺序：
    代码退出路径 → 信号（SIGPIPE/SIGSEGV）→ 外部 SIGKILL/OOM。
  3. **长驻 ipc daemon 必须考虑”客户端随时可能在回复前断开”**，
    这在 UI 进程会被重启的嵌入式场景里是高频事件，不是边缘情况。
  4. 机制类结论要有对照实验：光”改完好了”不算证明，要能展示”改之前必坏、改之后必好”。
  5. 每个长驻进程都应配保活看门狗；本项目已有 lvgl_watchdog.sh 的先例可照抄。

entry.title: 桌面FM图标渲染成方框
entry.content:
bugfix_20260922_04 — 桌面「FM 收音机」图标渲染成空心方框

关联提交：221fa7d

现象

在桌面新增「收音机」应用入口后，图标位置、底色（暖砖红 0xe6614f）、文字「收音机」
都正确，但图标本身是一个空心方框（tofu），不是任何有意义的图形。

影响范围

  • 只影响桌面「收音机」入口的图标。
  • 其它已有应用图标全部正常（它们用的都是字体里确实存在的字形）。
  • 不影响收音机页内部的功能与布局。

根因

launcher_page.c 里为 FM 选的图标码位在 lv_font_cn_16 中根本没有对应字形：

LVGL 渲染时 lv_font_get_glyph_dsc() 返回 not-found，就画成方框。
U+F519 属于 FontAwesome 5.x 才加入的图标，而本机中文字体
lv_font/font_cn.c（lv_font_cn_16）只覆盖 FontAwesome 4.x 的老子集。

定位过程

  1. 项目规范 §3.4 明确要求：图标可用性必须验证字形存在，不能用”码位区间覆盖”或
    “看着像”来推断    。桌面截图里 U+F519 是方框，与规范警告一致。
  2. 第一版探针 glyph_probe.c 只用了我记忆里的码位表，结果标签对应关系是错的
    （把 0xF050 当成 LV_SYMBOL_PREV、0xF0C9 当成 LV_SYMBOL_LIST）。
    → 教训：不要用人工映射的码位表去查字形。
  3. 重写 glyph_probe2.c：直接用 LV_SYMBOL_* 宏本身做输入，
    自己解 UTF-8 首字符得到码位，彻底消除人工映射错误。实测 52 项里
    有字形 46 / 缺 6，缺的正是 F519 / F2CE / F7C0 / F8CE / F130 / F09E。
  4. 再写 glyph_sweep.c 扫 U+F000..U+F8FF 全区间，得到权威清单：共 60 个图标。
    其中没有任何”电台 / 天线 / 电波”形状 —— 所以不能靠”换一个更像的码位”解决。
  5. 编译 glyph_probe* 时踩到的坑：lv_font_cn_16 定义在应用源码
    lv_font/font_cn.c 里（不属于 liblvgl.a），且静态库 liblvgl_thorvg.a
    含 C++ 目标文件 → **必须用 g++ 链接并直接带上 app 已编好的
    build/lv_font/font_cn.o**：（用 gcc 会报 undefined reference to lv_font_cn_16 与一堆 std:: 未定义。）

解决办法

从实测有字形的 60 个图标里，选语义最贴近”只能听声音的广播设备”、且未被现有
应用占用的 LV_SYMBOL_VOLUME_MAX（U+F028，喇叭带声波，18x16）：

（同时排查了现有 16 个应用的图标占用，避免撞车：DIRECTORY/EDIT/AUDIO/VIDEO/KEYBOARD/
SETTINGS/WIFI/BLUETOOTH/IMAGE/LIST/HOME/REFRESH/POWER/TINT/FILE 均已占用。）

验证

  • 重新编译部署后取桌面截图：「收音机」图标位置出现完整的喇叭图形（有人眼在物理屏确认），
    不再是方框；焦点框也正确落在该格上。
  • 留档图：shots/radio_icon_fix_rgb.png（正确字节序）。

经验教训

  1. 图标可用性只能靠 lv_font_get_glyph_dsc() 实证，不能靠码位表或”FontAwesome 区间覆盖”推断。
    本项目已因此踩过一次（U+F519）和一次探针自摆乌龙（人工码位映射错）。
  2. 写探针时要用”权威来源”本身做输入（这里是 LV_SYMBOL_* 宏），
    而不是自己转录一份映射表 —— 转录错误会让探针本身失去可信度。
  3. 先确认”到底有没有解法”再动手：扫描全区间后才知道这个字体根本没有电台形状，
    否则会一直在”换哪个码位”上浪费时间。
  4. 在这个项目里编译小探针要复用的是**应用已编好的 font_cn.o + g++**，
    不要试图重新编译 27MB 的 font_cn.c，也不要指望 liblvgl.a 里有 CJK 字体。

版权声明：本文为 whiteleibniz 原创文章（AI 协作整理），版权归 whiteleibniz 所有，转载请注明出处与原文链接：https://whiteleibniz.github.io

entry.title: mplayer Video Red/Blue Channel Swap
entry.content:
bugfix_20260922_01 Red/Blue Channel Swap in mplayer Video Playback

Symptom: after the desktop icon and FC game colors were corrected, the colors are still wrong when playing mp4 on the “Video” page (red and blue swapped).
Root cause layer: framebuffer color metadata × external player (mplayer -vo fbdev).
Fix effort: 2 source files +54/-2 and +50/-2, plus a miniretro rebuild.
File name: bugfix_20260922_01_mplayer视频红蓝通道错乱.md
Related commit: 5113a12
Date: 2026-09-22

1. Symptom

On the same screen, different functions show inconsistent colors:

FunctionColor behavior
Desktop icons, text, backgroundnormal (previously corrected)
FC games (miniretro)normal
mp4 played on the “Video” pagered and blue swapped (red objects display as blue)

Key point: only the video player is wrong. This itself shows the problem is not in “the screen’s entire color scheme”,
but in “the video player’s independent path”.

2. Scope of Impact

  • Affected: all videos played by the external mplayer process used by lv_pages/video_player_page.c.
  • Not affected: the LVGL self-drawing parts (desktop/various pages) and miniretro (FC games) —
    each has its own independent fb write path and its own local R/B swap, so no changes are needed.

3. Root Cause

3.1 Prerequisite: the machine’s real screen byte order is opposite to what the driver reports

FBIOGET_VSCREENINFO reports r16:8 g8:8 b0:8 (semantics [B,G,R,X]),
but writing solid colors to fb + visual confirmation shows the real byte order is [R,G,B,X]:

Memory bytes written to fbWhat the screen actually displays
[00,00,FF,FF]Blue
[FF,00,00,FF]Red

→ offset0 = red, offset2 = blue, exactly opposite to what the driver reports.

3.2 Core mechanism: the external player reads this metadata and writes pixels accordingly

The fbdev output driver of libs/mplayer/mplayer (MPlayer 1.4-13) reads
FBIOGET_VSCREENINFO at initialization, decides which byte to write each color to based on the read offsets,
and prints its chosen layout in the log:

  • BGRA = blue at byte 0 → but this panel wants red at byte 0 → red and blue are swapped on screen ✗
  • RGBA = red at byte 0 → matches the panel ✓

So mplayer’s code is not wrong; it just obediently follows the parameters the driver falsely reports.

3.3 Why this cannot be solved by changing code here

ConsumerHow it gets colorsCan code be changed?
LVGL (main.c fb_flush_cb)packs pixels itself, writes memory directly✅ already changed (swap R/B)
miniretro (scale_rotate90)packs pixels itself, writes memory directly✅ already changed (swap R/B)
mplayer (-vo fbdev)reads fb metadata and writes accordingly❌ third-party precompiled binary, no source code

mplayer is a 13.7 MB precompiled ELF (libs/mplayer/mplayer), and there is no source code on the device,
so its code cannot be changed — only the parameters it reads can be changed.

4. Localization Process

4.1 Detours Taken (recorded to avoid walking them again)

Wrong directionWhy it is wrong
Looking for mplayer in the system paths (/usr/bin, /usr/local/bin)none exist → at one point misjudged as “no player on the device”. It is actually at libs/mplayer/mplayer, hit by the relative-path candidates of video_find_mplayer()
Trying -vf format=bgr32 / format=rgb32 / format=bgraall ineffective. The fbdev vo overrides the format filter’s choice; the four output byte groups are exactly identical
Trying -vo fbdev2behaves the same as fbdev, still BGRA
Wanting to modify the custom lvfb driverthe lvfb (“LVGL-style framebuffer output”) driver does exist in this mplayer, but it rejects this machine’s format: [lvfb] unsupported framebuffer format: 720x1280 32bpp r16:8 g8:8 b0:8 (it still rejects after correction to r0:8 b16:8). There is no lvfb source code on the device, so it cannot be modified
Using ffmpeg -f lavfi to create solid-color test videosthe device has no ffmpeg; this route is blocked. Instead, compare directly with existing mp4 files

4.2 Decisive experiment: change only the fb var and see whether the output bytes change

Controlled variable: the same command, the same mp4, with the only change being the fb var.

Results (sampled at the screen center):

CaseVO: log lineScreen center bytes
A factory varVO: [fbdev] ... BGRA[e5 d7 cc ff]
B corrected varVO: [fbdev] ... RGBA[cc d7 e5 ff]

Only the R/B two bytes are swapped; everything else is exactly the same — cleanly pointing to the fb var as the single variable.

4.3 Key elimination experiment: does changing var affect the controller’s actual color sampling?

This is the watershed between “stacked correction” and “replacement correction”.

Approach: after correcting var to r0:8 b16:8, write the same [FF 00 00 FF] to fb,
and have the user visually report the color.

Result: the user answered “red” — exactly the same as the color seen before changing var.

Conclusion: red/green/blue.offset is just metadata for software to read; the controller ignores it.
Changing var does not affect hardware scan sampling; it only affects “software that reads this metadata” (i.e., mplayer).

→ Therefore the fix is additive: var must be corrected (to fix mplayer),
while the R/B swap in LVGL/miniretro themselves must be kept (deleting it would double-swap and revert to wrong).

5. Solution

5.1 Add an idempotent var correction function

Call it once in fb_init() (immediately after opening fb) to correct var to r0:8 g8:8 b16:8:

5.2 Call it at both fb_init() sites

FileLocationEffect
main.cafter fb_init() opens g_fb_fdmplayer is a child process of lvgl_demo, so it naturally inherits the correct state
extern/miniretro/miniretro.cafter fb_init() opens fb_fdwhen running games standalone, separated from the main program, the fb state is also correct

5.3 Parts that remain unchanged (important)

  • main.c‘s fb_flush_cb: keep the R/B swap
  • extern/miniretro/miniretro.c‘s scale_rotate90: keep the R/B swap

These two write memory directly and do not read metadata; deleting the swap would double-swap and revert to wrong.

6. Verification

6.1 Automated verification (whether var self-heals + whether the mplayer layout changes)

Live result: var automatically changed from r16:8 g8:8 b0:8 to r0:8 g8:8 b16:8,
the log printed [fb] color spec -> r0:8 g8:8 b16:8, and the mplayer layout changed from BGRA to RGBA. ✓

6.2 Visual verification (required)

The user opens “Video” on the device → plays mp4 → visually confirms the picture colors.

User confirmation result: “The colors are correct now”. ✓

6.3 Regression verification (confirm nothing already fixed was broken)

  • The 16 desktop icon colors were checked one by one against the s_apps[] color table → all match
    (Bluetooth #1e88e5, Network #56ccf2, Power off #e74c3c, Music #eb5757, LED light control #ffb300 …)
  • FC game colors → normal
  • Deployment verification: md5sum /usr/local/bin/lvgl_demo build/lvgl_demo — the two are identical ✓

7. Lessons Learned

  1. “On the same screen, different processes are fixed differently” — this was the biggest cognitive leap this time.
    Consumers that write fb fall into three categories:

    • Self-drawing programs (LVGL, miniretro) → change the code, swapping at their own write points
    • External programs that read metadata (mplayer -vo fbdev) → change the parameters (correct the fb var)
    • Kernel/controller → usually not modifiable, and measured to ignore var

    Fixing only one category leaves “some function’s colors still wrong”. The first step in troubleshooting color problems should be to enumerate all processes that write fb.

  2. Look at the choice the external program prints itself first. mplayer’s VO: [fbdev] ... BGRA line
    directly shows the basis of its judgment, faster than any reasoning. When there are logs, do not guess.

  3. A controlled-variable A/B experiment beats “change a bunch and try again”. Same command + same material + changing only one variable
    (fb var) yielded the clean conclusion “only the R/B two bytes swapped”, locking in the causality directly.

  4. Distinguish “metadata” from “hardware behavior”. Before changing var.red.offset, ask first:
    “Is it used by hardware, or only read by software?” — this can be answered by “write the same bytes before and after the change and see whether the screen changes”.
    This judgment determines whether the fix is additive or replacement, and getting it wrong causes a double swap.

  5. Verify command-line options before giving up on them. -vf format=... and -vo fbdev2 look reasonable,
    but live testing shows they are all ineffective. Spending a few minutes to disprove them beats recompiling the player on intuition.

  6. Do not use pkill -f <pattern> to kill daemons. pkill -9 -f lvgl_watchdog matches
    the shell itself carrying the command (its command line contains that string) → kills your own SSH session,
    manifesting as RC: -1 with truncated output, looking like “the command did not execute at all”. Kill by PID:

  7. After patching a remote machine, review with git diff --ignore-cr-at-eol.
    git diff once displayed a 54-line real change as 1618 lines of “whole-file rewrite” —
    that was just CRLF/LF triggering git’s line-ending heuristic, not a broken change.

Appendix: Files Involved

entry.title: FM daemon Exits Silently Due to SIGPIPE
entry.content:
bugfix_20260922_03 — FM daemon disappears for no reason; the radio page always shows “芯片 0000”

Related commit: 221fa7d

Symptoms

After running for a while, fm_user_daemon disappears without a sound (it cannot be found in ps; the socket file /tmp/fm_ctl.sock still exists, but connect() returns Connection refused).
As a result, the radio page always shows 芯片 0000, RDS 不可用, and 已关闭, and all buttons are unresponsive.
The last few lines of the log contain only the normal cmd='state' / cmd='rssi' entries, with no crash information at all.

Scope of impact

  • Only the FM radio function is affected (the page ↔ daemon link is completely broken).
  • The main lvgl_demo program is not affected: lvgl_demo has its own /root/lvgl_watchdog.sh keep-alive and has always run normally.
  • All functions that depend on a permanently open fd for /dev/fm are affected: once the daemon dies, /dev/fm is closed, which triggers fm_release (it sends at+fm=12 and blocks for about 4s), and the FM state is lost.

Root cause

A plain write() on a socket whose peer has already closed triggers SIGPIPE, whose default action is to terminate the process.

The daemon’s reply function used to be:

and main() does not call signal(SIGPIPE, SIG_IGN).

Meanwhile, it is normal for the client (the lvgl_demo radio page) to disconnect “before the reply is written out”:

  • The connection is closed when the page runs onDestroy or the application is killed with killall;
  • The page’s IO worker thread sets a 6s timeout for the rssi command, but the kernel GETRSSI takes ~4s; the page also reconnects after the timeout → the old connection is discarded.

Once this happens, the daemon is killed by SIGPIPE, with no log whatsoever (the default signal action produces no user-space output).

Diagnosis process

  1. First confirm that the process is really gone and that the socket is stale (pidof is empty, Connection refused).
  2. Look at the daemon source code’s exit paths: the for(;;) accept(...) loop in main() after setup is an infinite loop with no explicit exit() at all; none of the command branches has one either. → Rule out “the logic exited by itself”.
  3. That leaves only “killed by a signal / segfault”. Grep for signals and write operations:
  4. The timeline matches: every “daemon disappearance” happened after I restarted the lvgl_demo application.
  5. Run a control experiment to prove the mechanism (ssh_tools/sigpipe_ctrl.c): fork two child processes, each of which calls socketpair() and then closes the peer; group A uses a bare write() and group B uses send(..., MSG_NOSIGNAL):Group A produced no output at all → it was indeed terminated by SIGPIPE. The mechanism is confirmed on this machine.

Solution

Two changes (ssh_tools/fm_user_daemon.c):

  1. Unify the socket write function so that it never produces SIGPIPE:
    • reply() is switched to use it;
    • Writing "wcn FM-OPEN" to @wcnd inside wcnd_fm_open() is also switched to it (it is likewise a socket whose peer may already be disconnected).
  2. Add a fallback at the beginning of main():

Also add a keep-alive watchdog /root/fm_watchdog.sh (every 5 seconds it runs pidof fm_user_daemon and restarts the daemon if it is absent, following the same pattern as the existing /root/lvgl_watchdog.sh), defending against other causes of death such as OOM/SIGKILL.

Verification

  • Regression test (device-side python3 /root/fm_sigpipe_test.py): 6 rounds of “connect → send rssi (the kernel takes ~4s to reply) → close() immediately after 0.15s”, exactly the worst-case timing that used to be guaranteed to kill it.
    Result: all 6 rounds survived, and the daemon pid stayed at 6408 throughout → PASSED.
  • Control experiment (the sigpipe_ctrl from the previous section): group A died silently / group B survived → counter-proof that the fix is necessary and effective.
  • After restarting the application and re-entering the radio page, the page again shows RDS 可用 · 芯片 2341 · 收听中.
  • After the device rebooted on its own, /etc/local.d/zz_fm.start automatically brought the daemon up (log entries [fm] wcn FM-OPEN -> WCNBTWIFI-CMD OK, chipid=0x2341 rds=1, 就绪，监听 /tmp/fm_ctl.sock).

Lessons learned

  1. Always use send(..., MSG_NOSIGNAL) when writing to sockets, and call signal(SIGPIPE, SIG_IGN) at the beginning of long-running processes.
    SIGPIPE is a “silent killer”: it produces no log at all, and the symptom is “the process mysteriously disappeared”, which is very easily misdiagnosed as OOM or “it exited by itself”.
  2. “No exit() but the process is gone” → suspect signals first. Order of investigation: code exit paths → signals (SIGPIPE/SIGSEGV) → external SIGKILL/OOM.
  3. A long-running IPC daemon must account for “the client may disconnect at any time before the reply”; this is a high-frequency event, not an edge case, in embedded scenarios where the UI process gets restarted.
  4. Mechanism-level conclusions need a control experiment: merely “it works after the change” does not count as proof; you must be able to show “it always failed before and always works after”.
  5. Every long-running process should have a keep-alive watchdog; this project already has the precedent of lvgl_watchdog.sh that can be copied.

entry.title: Radio Ruler Marks All Crowded to the Left
entry.content:
bugfix_20260922_02 — All marks on the radio page ruler are crowded to the left

Related commit: 221fa7d

Symptoms

On the newly added “FM Radio” page (lv_pages/radio_page.c), the frequency ruler in area D (covering 88~108 MHz, which should span the full width of the card) has all tick marks, numeric labels, and favorite squares crowded within roughly the leftmost 10px of the card. To the naked eye it looks like a small vertically stacked pile of ghosting; the entire right side is blank.

Scope of impact

  • Only the ruler in radio_page.c is affected (rp_ruler_rebuild() / rp_ruler_pointer_update()).
  • All other sections on the same page (title bar, current frequency, signal bar, control buttons, favorites list, volume bar) are unaffected — their coordinates are hard-coded constants that do not depend on a runtime width query.
  • No other page is affected.

Root cause

In LVGL 9, lv_obj_get_width() returns the cached coordinate area obj->coords, not the value just passed to lv_obj_set_size().

Evidence (device-side source code):

coords is only refreshed during a layout cycle (lv_obj_update_layout / refresh). However, rp_ruler_rebuild() is called in onCreate() immediately after lv_obj_set_size(marks, w, 78). At that moment the layout has not run yet, so coords is still all zeros → lv_obj_get_width() returns 0.

The code also contains a “fallback” that hides the problem even deeper:

As a result, all 21 tick marks + 6 labels + 5 favorite squares land at x=0~9, which visually appears as a pile on the left.

Diagnosis process

  1. First look at the full-page screenshot: all other sections are correct and only the ruler collapsed → first suspect that the container layout (flex) took over the child object coordinates.
  2. Add a temporary probe inside rp_ruler_rebuild() to print the runtime geometry directly:Measured output:→ get_width=10 instead of the expected 652 (=720-24-44). The coordinates themselves are fine; only the width value is wrong.
  3. grep lv_obj_get_width in the source code and confirm that it reads coords, which locks in the root cause.
  4. Ruled-out wrong directions:
    • Suspected that lv_obj_set_layout(marks, LV_LAYOUT_NONE) did not take effect and flex took over → No, set_pos itself did take effect;
    • Suspected “label x-12 out of bounds” → That is another real but secondary problem (see the “Note” below).

Solution

Cache the width that was explicitly set at creation time and stop relying on a runtime width query (remote_src/radio_page.c):

The three pieces of code that use the width (tick x, favorite square x, pointer x) are all switched to rp_ruler_width().

A second bug in the same function is fixed at the same time: the pointer used to be a child object of marks, and the first thing rp_ruler_rebuild() does is lv_obj_clean(marks) — which deletes the pointer along with everything else, turning s_rp.ruler_pointer into a dangling pointer. This is now fixed by recreating the pointer after the clean and immediately calling rp_ruler_pointer_update().

Note (a third issue fixed in passing): the tick x values were originally mapped across the full width [0, w] with center-aligned labels, which caused the rightmost “108” to be clipped by the card edge (the measured screenshot only showed “10”). After adding left/right padding RP_RULER_PAD 14, the labels at both ends are fully visible.

Verification

  1. Recompile and deploy: ssh_tools/radio_dev.py remote_src/radio_page.c:lv_pages/radio_page.c
  2. Navigate into the radio page using standard key code injection (see the key code description in bugfix_03), or directly use ssh_tools/radio_page_snap.py
  3. Look at the physical screen with your own eyes (the screenshot is only for the record): the ruler spans the card horizontally, and all six labels 88/92/96/100/104/108 are fully visible; long ticks on even MHz alternate with short ticks on odd MHz; the 5 favorite red squares and the current-frequency pointer fall at the correct proportional positions (87.5 at the far left, 106.1 toward the right).
  4. Local zoom re-check: python ssh_tools/zoom_crop.py shots/_fb_tmp.raw shots/zoom_ruler2.png 0 262 720 108 2
    → The result confirms the fix.

Lessons learned

  1. In LVGL 9, the lv_obj_get_*() family (width/height/x/y) all read the cached coords, not “the value just set”. For any scenario of “create an object → immediately compute child object coordinates from its size”, you must cache that size yourself, or first call lv_obj_update_layout(obj) explicitly. This is a pitfall that fails silently (it returns 0).
  2. A “fallback” if can turn a bug from “crash / obvious anomaly” into “a wrong value that looks like it runs”: if (w < 10) w = 10; turned 0 into 10, and the symptom changed from “nothing at all” to “everything crowded on the left”, costing one extra round of diagnosis. A fallback value should either be of the same order of magnitude as the normal value, or the code should simply report an error.
  3. lv_obj_clean(parent) deletes all child objects of parent. A persistent handle must not be attached to a container that will be cleaned; otherwise it must be explicitly recreated after the clean.
  4. Before setting coordinates for container children, first confirm that the container’s layout is NONE (the other cards on this page happened not to be taken over by flex).
  5. The most cost-effective means of debugging UI geometry issues: add one fprintf line inside the function to print the runtime numbers — this is an order of magnitude faster than guessing against screenshots.

entry.title: Desktop FM Icon Renders as an Empty Box
entry.content:
bugfix_20260922_04 — The desktop “FM Radio” icon renders as an empty box

Related commit: 221fa7d

Symptoms

After adding the “Radio” app entry to the desktop, the icon position, background color (warm brick red 0xe6614f), and the text “收音机” are all correct, but the icon itself is an empty box (tofu), not any meaningful graphic.

Scope of impact

  • Only the icon of the desktop “Radio” entry is affected.
  • All other existing app icons are normal (they all use glyphs that actually exist in the font).
  • The internal function and layout of the radio page are not affected.

Root cause

The icon code point selected for FM in launcher_page.c has no corresponding glyph at all in lv_font_cn_16:

During LVGL rendering, lv_font_get_glyph_dsc() returns not-found, so a box is drawn.
U+F519 is an icon introduced only in FontAwesome 5.x, whereas the machine’s Chinese font lv_font/font_cn.c (lv_font_cn_16) covers only the old FontAwesome 4.x subset.

Diagnosis process

  1. Project specification §3.4 explicitly requires: icon availability must be verified by checking that the glyph exists; it must not be inferred from “code point range coverage” or “it looks like it”. In the desktop screenshot, U+F519 is a box, consistent with the specification’s warning.
  2. The first probe version, glyph_probe.c, used only the code point table from my memory, and as a result the label mapping was wrong (treating 0xF050 as LV_SYMBOL_PREV and 0xF0C9 as LV_SYMBOL_LIST).
    → Lesson: do not use a manually mapped code point table to look up glyphs.
  3. Rewrite glyph_probe2.c: use the LV_SYMBOL_* macros themselves as input, decode the first UTF-8 character to obtain the code point, and completely eliminate manual mapping errors. Of the measured 52 items, 46 have glyphs and 6 are missing, the missing ones being exactly F519 / F2CE / F7C0 / F8CE / F130 / F09E.
  4. Then write glyph_sweep.c to sweep the entire range U+F000..U+F8FF, yielding the authoritative list: 60 icons in total.
    None of them has a “radio station / antenna / radio wave” shape — so the problem cannot be solved by “switching to a more similar-looking code point”.
  5. Pitfalls encountered when compiling glyph_probe*: lv_font_cn_16 is defined in the application source lv_font/font_cn.c (it is not part of liblvgl.a), and the static library liblvgl_thorvg.a contains C++ object files → you must link with g++ and directly include the app’s already-built build/lv_font/font_cn.o:(Using gcc reports undefined reference to lv_font_cn_16 along with a bunch of undefined std:: symbols.)

Solution

From the 60 icons measured to have glyphs, choose LV_SYMBOL_VOLUME_MAX (U+F028, a speaker with sound waves, 18x16), whose semantics best match “a broadcast device that can only play sound” and which is not occupied by any existing application:

(At the same time, the icon usage of the existing 16 applications was checked to avoid collisions: DIRECTORY/EDIT/AUDIO/VIDEO/KEYBOARD/SETTINGS/WIFI/BLUETOOTH/IMAGE/LIST/HOME/REFRESH/POWER/TINT/FILE are all already occupied.)

Verification

  • After recompiling, deploying, and taking a desktop screenshot: a complete speaker graphic appears at the “Radio” icon position (confirmed by human eyes on the physical screen), no longer a box; the focus frame also lands correctly on that cell.
  • Archived image: shots/radio_icon_fix_rgb.png (correct byte order).

Lessons learned

  1. Icon availability can only be verified empirically via lv_font_get_glyph_dsc(); it cannot be inferred from a code point table or “FontAwesome range coverage”.
    This project has already stepped on this once (U+F519) and once had a probe self-inflicted mishap (wrong manual code point mapping).
  2. When writing a probe, use the “authoritative source” itself as input (here, the LV_SYMBOL_* macros), rather than transcribing a mapping table yourself — transcription errors make the probe itself lose credibility.
  3. First confirm “whether a solution exists at all” before acting: only after sweeping the entire range did we learn that this font has no radio shape at all; otherwise we would have kept wasting time on “which code point to switch to”.
  4. To compile small probes in this project, you need to reuse the app’s already-built font_cn.o plus g++; do not try to recompile the 27MB font_cn.c, and do not expect liblvgl.a to contain a CJK font.

entry.title: 收音機刻度尺全擠在左側
entry.content:
bugfix_20260922_02 — 收音機頁刻度尺所有刻度擠在左側

關聯提交：221fa7d

現象

新增的「FM 收音機」頁面（lv_pages/radio_page.c）中，D 區頻率刻度尺（覆蓋 88~108 MHz，
應橫向鋪滿卡片）所有刻度線、數字標籤、收藏方塊全部擠在卡片最左側約 10px 內，
肉眼看起來就是一小坨豎著堆疊的重影；右側整片空白。

影響範圍

  • 隻影響 radio_page.c 的刻度尺（rp_ruler_rebuild() / rp_ruler_pointer_update()）。
  • 同頁面其它分區（標題欄、當前頻點、信號柱、控制按鈕、收藏列表、音量條）不受影響 ——
    它們的座標是寫死的常量，不依賴運行時取寬。
  • 不影響任何其它頁面。

根因

LVGL 9 的 lv_obj_get_width() 返回的是緩存座標區 obj->coords，而不是剛 lv_obj_set_size() 設進去的值。

證據（設備端源碼）：

coords 只在佈局週期（lv_obj_update_layout / 刷新）裡才被刷新。而
rp_ruler_rebuild() 是在 onCreate() 裡緊跟著 lv_obj_set_size(marks, w, 78) 調用的，
此刻佈局還沒跑過，coords 仍是全 0 → lv_obj_get_width() 返回 0。

代碼裡還有一句”兜底”把問題藏得更深：

於是 21 個刻度 + 6 個標籤 + 5 個收藏方塊全部落在 x=0~9，視覺上就是左側一坨。

定位過程

  1. 先看整頁截圖：其它分區都對，只有刻度尺塌了 → 先懷疑是容器佈局（flex）接管了子對象座標。
  2. 在 rp_ruler_rebuild() 里加臨時探針，直接打印運行時幾何：實測輸出：→ get_width=10 而不是應有的 652（=720-24-44）。座標本身沒問題，就是寬度取值錯了。
  3. grep lv_obj_get_width 到源碼，確認它讀 coords，鎖定根因。
  4. 排除過的錯誤方向：
    • 曾懷疑 lv_obj_set_layout(marks, LV_LAYOUT_NONE) 沒生效被 flex 接管 → 不是，set_pos 本身生效了；
    • 曾懷疑是”標籤 x-12 越界” → 那是另一個真實但次要的問題（見下”注”）。

解決辦法

把創建時顯式設過的寬度緩存下來，不再依賴運行時取寬（remote_src/radio_page.c）：

三處用寬度的代碼（刻度 x、收藏方塊 x、指針 x）統一改走 rp_ruler_width()。

同時修掉同一函數里的第二個 bug：指針原本是 marks 的子對象，而
rp_ruler_rebuild() 第一件事就是 lv_obj_clean(marks) —— 會把指針一起刪掉，
s_rp.ruler_pointer 變成懸垂指針。現改為在 clean 之後重新創建指針並立即
rp_ruler_pointer_update()。

注（順帶修的第三個問題）：刻度 x 原本按 [0, w] 滿寬映射，標籤以中心對齊，
導致最右的 “108” 被卡片邊緣裁掉（實測截圖只顯示 “10”）。加左右內縮
RP_RULER_PAD 14 後兩端標籤都能完整顯示。

驗證

  1. 重新編譯部署：ssh_tools/radio_dev.py remote_src/radio_page.c:lv_pages/radio_page.c
  2. 用標準鍵碼注入導航進收音機頁（見 bugfix_03 的鍵碼說明），或直接 ssh_tools/radio_page_snap.py
  3. 人眼看物理屏（截圖僅作留檔）：刻度尺橫向鋪滿，88/92/96/100/104/108 六個標籤
    全部完整可見，偶數 MHz 長刻度 / 奇數 MHz 短刻度交替，5 個收藏紅方塊與當前頻點指針
    落在正確比例位置（87.5 在最左、106.1 在偏右）。
  4. 局部放大複核：python ssh_tools/zoom_crop.py shots/_fb_tmp.raw shots/zoom_ruler2.png 0 262 720 108 2
    → 結果確認修好。

經驗教訓

  1. LVGL 9 裡 lv_obj_get_*() 系列（width/height/x/y）讀的都是緩存 coords，不是”剛設進去的值”。
    凡是”創建對象 → 立刻按它的尺寸算子對象座標”的場景，都必須自己緩存那個尺寸，
    或者先顯式 lv_obj_update_layout(obj)。這是一個會靜默出錯（返回 0）的坑。
  2. **”兜底” if 會把 bug 從”崩潰/明顯異常”變成”看起來能跑的錯值”**：
    if (w < 10) w = 10; 讓 0 變成了 10，症狀從”什麼都沒有”變成”全擠在左邊”，
    多花了一輪才定位。兜底值要麼等於正常量級，要麼就該直接報錯。
  3. lv_obj_clean(parent) 會刪掉 parent 的所有子對象。常駐句柄不能掛在會被
    clean 的容器下；否則必須顯式地在 clean 之後重建。
  4. 給容器子對象設座標前，先確認容器的 layout 是 NONE（本頁其它卡片恰好沒被 flex 接管）。
  5. 調試界面幾何問題的性價比最高手段：在函數里打一行 fprintf 把運行時數字打出來，
    比對著截圖猜快一個數量級。

entry.title: FM_daemon因SIGPIPE靜默退出
entry.content:
bugfix_20260922_03 — FM daemon 無故消失，收音機頁永遠顯示”芯片 0000”

關聯提交：221fa7d

現象

fm_user_daemon 運行一段時間後無聲無息地消失（ps 裡找不到，socket 文件
/tmp/fm_ctl.sock 還在但 connect() 返回 Connection refused）。
收音機頁因此永遠顯示 芯片 0000、RDS 不可用、已關閉，所有按鈕點了沒反應。
日誌的最後幾行只有正常的 cmd='state' / cmd='rssi'，完全沒有崩潰信息。

影響範圍

  • 隻影響 FM 收音機功能（頁面 ↔ daemon 鏈路全斷）。
  • 不影響 lvgl_demo 主體：lvgl_demo 有自己的 /root/lvgl_watchdog.sh 保活，一直正常。
  • 影響所有依賴 /dev/fm 常開 fd 的功能：daemon 一死，/dev/fm 被 close 觸發
    fm_release（發 at+fm=12 並阻塞約 4s），FM 狀態丟失。

根因

對端已關閉的 socket 上做普通 write() 會觸發 SIGPIPE，其默認動作是終止進程。

daemon 的回寫函數原本是：

且 main() 裡沒有 signal(SIGPIPE, SIG_IGN)。

而客戶端（lvgl_demo 收音機頁）在”回覆寫出之前”斷開是常態：

  • 頁面 onDestroy/應用被 killall 時連接被關；
  • 頁面的 IO 工作線程對 rssi 命令設 6s 超時，但內核 GETRSSI 要 ~4s；
    頁面還會在超時後重連 → 舊連接被丟棄。

一旦發生，daemon 被 SIGPIPE 打死，沒有任何日誌（信號默認動作，不產生用戶態輸出）。

定位過程

  1. 先確認進程真的沒了、socket 是陳舊的（pidof 空、Connection refused）。
  2. 看 daemon 源碼的退出路徑：main() 裡 setup 之後的 for(;;) accept(...) 是死循環，
    **沒有任何主動 exit()**；各命令分支也沒有。→ 排除”邏輯自己退出”。
  3. 於是只剩”被信號殺死 / 段錯誤”。grep 信號與寫操作：
  4. 時間線吻合：每次”daemon 消失”都發生在我重啟 lvgl_demo 應用之後。
  5. 做對照實驗證明機制（ssh_tools/sigpipe_ctrl.c）：fork 兩個子進程，各自
    socketpair() 後關掉對端，A 組用裸 write()、B 組用 send(..., MSG_NOSIGNAL)：A 組完全沒有輸出 → 確實被 SIGPIPE 終止。 機制在本機得到證實。

解決辦法

兩處修改（ssh_tools/fm_user_daemon.c）：

  1. 統一 socket 寫函數，永不產生 SIGPIPE：
    • reply() 改用它；
    • wcnd_fm_open() 裡向 @wcnd 寫 "wcn FM-OPEN" 也改用它（同樣是對端可能已斷的 socket）。
  2. main() 開頭加兜底：

另加保活看門狗 /root/fm_watchdog.sh（每 5 秒 pidof fm_user_daemon，不在就拉起，
模式與既有 /root/lvgl_watchdog.sh 一致），防禦 OOM/SIGKILL 等其它死法。

驗證

  • 迴歸測試（設備端 python3 /root/fm_sigpipe_test.py）：6 輪”連上 → 發 rssi
    （內核要 ~4s 才回）→ 0.15s 後立刻 close()“，正是原本必死的最壞時序。
    結果：6 輪全部存活，daemon pid 始終 6408 不變 → PASSED。
  • 對照實驗（上節 sigpipe_ctrl）：A 組靜默死亡 / B 組存活 → 反證修復必要且有效。
  • 重啟應用後重進收音機頁，頁面恢復顯示 RDS 可用 · 芯片 2341 · 收聽中。
  • 設備自行重啟後，/etc/local.d/zz_fm.start 自動把 daemon 拉起（日誌
    [fm] wcn FM-OPEN -> WCNBTWIFI-CMD OK、chipid=0x2341 rds=1、就緒，監聽 /tmp/fm_ctl.sock）。

經驗教訓

  1. 寫 socket 一律用 send(..., MSG_NOSIGNAL)，並在長駐進程開頭 signal(SIGPIPE, SIG_IGN)。
    SIGPIPE 是”靜默殺手”：不產生任何日誌，現象是”進程莫名消失”，
    極易被誤判為 OOM 或”自己退出了”。
  2. “沒有 exit() 但進程沒了” → 優先懷疑信號。 排查順序：
    代碼退出路徑 → 信號（SIGPIPE/SIGSEGV）→ 外部 SIGKILL/OOM。
  3. **長駐 ipc daemon 必須考慮”客戶端隨時可能在回覆前斷開”**，
    這在 UI 進程會被重啟的嵌入式場景裡是高頻事件，不是邊緣情況。
  4. 機制類結論要有對照實驗：光”改完好了”不算證明，要能展示”改之前必壞、改之後必好”。
  5. 每個長駐進程都應配保活看門狗；本項目已有 lvgl_watchdog.sh 的先例可照抄。
